श्री मान जी,
विनम्र निवेदन है कि ग्राम हलेड़ जुन्गथ , डाकघर भब्बर , तहसील पठानकोट का मैदान अधूरी हालत में है, सात साल पहले गांव में बच्चों और युवाओं के खेलने के लिए कोई मैदान नहीं था, गांव के बच्चे और युवा गांव में मैदान नहीं था, इस वजह से खाली समय में खाली बैठे रहते थे, बुजुर्गों का कहना है कि खाली दिमाग शैतान का घर होता है, यह कहावत हमारे गांव में सच होती देखी गई थी, 15से 20 साल पहले लोग सुबह से शाम तक कृषि और पशुपालन में लगे रहते थे , बच्चे स्कूल से आने के बाद कृषि और पशुपालन में व्यस्त रहते थे, आजकल लगभग सभी परिवारों ने कृषि और पशुपालन गतिविधियों को कम या छोड़ दिया है, जिसके कारण स्कूल से आने के बाद और एतवार के दिन तथा अन्य छुट्टियों के दिन बच्चों के पास अक्सर फ्री समय रहता है, खाली समय में ग्राउंड न होने के कारण से, गांव के बच्चे और युवा नशे की ओर आकर्षित होने लगे, कुछ बच्चे और युवा नशे के आदी हो गए, इस संबंध में गांव के लोगों ने हर छोटे-बड़े अधिकारी को खबर दी और सत्ता में आने वाली हर सरकार के सामने गांव में एक अच्छा ग्राउंड बनाने की गुहार लगाई, गांव के 150 घरों के लिए किसी ने कोई ग्राउंड नहीं बनाई, जिसके बाद युवा समिति और गांव वालों ने खुद कुछ धन इकट्ठा किया, और एक अधूरा मैदान बना दिया गया, पैसे के अभाव में यह मैदान पूरा नहीं हो पाया, यह अधूरा रह गया, आसपास के चार पांच गांवों में मैदान नहीं है, जिससे उन गांवों के बच्चे भी इस मैदान में खेलने आते हैं, तो बच्चों तथा युवाओं को ग्राउंड में खेलने में बहुत असुविधा होती है, लगभग हजार के आसपास घरों के लिए यह एक अकेला बड़ा मैदान है, जो कि अधूरा है, इसलिए गांव की युवा समिति ने अब फिर गांव हलेड जुन्गथ तथा गांव जुन्गथ टीका त्रिहाड़ी के युवाओं द्वारा पैसे इकट्ठे कर फिर ग्राउंड का कार्य शुरू किया गया है, ग्राउंड के इस कार्य में पहले सरकार द्वारा हमारी कोई सहायता नहीं की गई थी, आपसे तथा वर्तमान सरकार से विनम्र निवेदन है कि कृपया इस मैदान को पूर्ण कराएं, और हमारी इस कार्य के लिए मदद करें, पूरा गांव आपका सदैव आभारी रहेगा।

We are the manufacturers of Tennis Balls from Meerut. We were established in 2014 and till now we were dealing in domestic market only. USA is the biggest market in the world for the supply of pet toys. We have been in correspondence with world's leading companies established in the USA who are currently importing from China. Each and every single company is interested to shift their vendor from China to India. We sent the samples to a lot of companies in USA and they liked our ball.
Companies like Walmart conducted audit as they are keenly interested to start business relationships with India.
We have owned space of around 1000 sq yard in which we can produce [number] balls per day but their capacity and requirement is so huge that they need an alternate of Chinese factories that are making more that [number] balls per day. We can set up this plant as we have great experience in this field. For making [number] balls per day we will need a space of around 5000 sq yards.
We look forward to boost the exports of our country. I can assure you that if this plant is set up we can be the biggest exporter from Meerut city.
One of the main reason that USA buyers are interested is that USA has waived off the import duty on this product from India which means they will save more than ₹[number] on every container.
We have every other thing but we need land for this project.
I have attached the report of our factory conducted by Walmart. They have committed us to buy 5 crore balls every year.
Looking forward to hearing from you.

⏎ સહ વિનય સાથ જણાવવાનું કે હાલ આપણા દેશ માટે માનનીય વડા પ્રધાન દેશને નવી દિશા તેમજ દેશનું ઉજ્વળ ભવિષ્ય માટે નિરંતર દેશ દુનિયામાં એક અલગ ઓળખ સાથે ઉજ્વળ ભારત નવા શિખરો સર કરતા લોકો ખુબ ગર્વ અનુભવે છે અને બીજી તરફ દેશની અંદર ટેલિવિઝન પર થી ફેમસ એક્ટર તેમજ અન્ય એવા સમાજ માં પ્રભુત્વ ધરાવતા લોકો દ્વારા જંગલી રમી તેમજ ડ્રીમ 11, તીન પતી, જેવી રમતો રમી લાખો કરોડો કમાવો એવા પ્રલોબંધ આપતા હોય છે જેથી લોકો આવા વિશ્વાસ માં મુકાઈ ને અંતે ભારે રકમ ગુમાવવી પડતી હોય છે સાથે પરિવાર દેવામાં ધકેલાય છે અને વ્યક્તિ આત્મહત્યા કરીલે છે. તેમજ કોઈ પરિવાર સામૂહિક આત્મ હત્યા કરી લેતું હોય છે. ખાસ આ પ્રકાર નાં આપણા દેશમાં ખૂબ વ્યાપક પ્રમાણમાં આવા અનેક બનાવો બને છે. તેમજ સાથે સાથે દેશનું યુવા ધન ગેર માર્ગે દોરાય છે. ટેલિવિઝન પર આવતા વિજ્ઞાપન પર રોક લગાવવી રહી. એમ પણ અમુક લોકો ભેગા મળીને લાઈવ જુગાર રમે એ ગેરકાયદેસર હોય તો આવા સ્માર્ટ ફોનની ઓનલાઈન જંગલી રમી કે અન્ય રમતો રમવી અને એ એપ્લિકેન્સ, સોફ્ટવેર ને મંજૂરી આપવી સાથે લોક સાહના ધરાવતા વ્યક્તિ ઓ જેમકે ક્રિકેટર, એક્ટર પાસે તેમના વિજ્ઞાપન કરાવવું આતો કેવી રીતે ? આનાથી દેશમાં ફક્ત ને ફક્ત બરબાદી શિવાય દૂર સુધી કંઈ દેખાતુંજ નથી માટે આપ આદરણીય સાહેબશ્રી ને નમ્ર વિનંતી સાથે જણાવવાનું કે આવા ફેલાતા દૂષણ સામે દેશનાં ભવિષ્ય માટે કોઈ સારા નિર્ણયની આપ પાસેથી આશા સહ આપનો આભાર.

Sports >> Sports Federations Related >> Volleyball
⏎ -----------------------
A team of 12 girls and 2 coaches were selected by Volleyball Association of India to participate in the first Asian womens U16 championship to take place between 1st July and 8th July 2023 at Hangzhou China. They underwent training for 1 month at Bhubaneshwar and arrived in mumbai on 27th June for onward journey to China. Their tickets were booked for 28th June but since there was a delay in getting visas because of server problem their tickets were postponed to 30th June 2023. We understand at the last moment the Ministry has cancelled the tour because of the infighting among the volleyball association and adhoc commitee. Because of this fight the career of these kids should not at stake. I request you to take up this matter with the Ministry and ensure that this tour is not cancelled. Please sir this is a request and as a last resort i am writing to you. This is urgent because their flight is at 10 pm today ie 30th July 2023.

DSPRT/E/2023/0000241.d:
सेवा मे,
खेल मंत्रालय, भारत सरकार
एवं सहयोगी भारतीय सेना से सबंध खेल प्रबंधन
श्रीमानजी,
सविनय निवेदन है की आप के आर्मी बॉय्ज़ स्पोर्ट्स कंपनी स्कीम (ए. बी. एस. सी.) प्रबंधन के तहत राजपूत राइफल रेजीमेंट फतेहगढ़ उत्तर प्रदेश मे विद्यार्थियों का चयन ज्ञातव्य के अनुसार 8 से 14 वर्षीय बच्चे जो किसी खेल मे उत्कृष्ठता होने पर या विभाग द्वरा प्रशिक्षण परीक्षा से चयनित छात्र किया जाना या होना संभाव्य है। परंतु उक्त संस्थान मे क्या फर्जी प्रमाण पत्रों से भी किसी दबाव के कारण अयोग्य छात्रों का भी चयन होना संभव है ? मेरे मतानुसार यह संभव नहीं फिर भी यदि ऐसे व्यक्ति / छात्र जो वस्तुतः माध्यमिक शिक्षा परिषद उत्तर प्रदेश द्वारा 10वीं कक्षा पास व्यक्ति का भी चयन संभव है? इस हेतु प्रार्थना पत्र प्रस्तुत कर उपरोक्त बिंदुओं के बारे मे स्पष्टता की अभिलाषा है।

PMOPG/E/2023/0130855.d:
The Prime Minister's Office
South Block, Raisina Hill
New Delhi - [number]
India
⏎ Subject: Request for a Distinctive Logo for the [address] of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI)
⏎ Respected Prime Minister,
⏎ I hope this letter finds you in good health and high spirits. Firstly, I would like to extend my warmest regards on the occasion of the ongoing 75th Azadika Amrit Mahotsav, a milestone that fills every Indian heart with pride and gratitude. I greatly appreciate your vision of urging our nation to shed the remnants of colonialism and embrace a mindset of self-reliance and true independence.
⏎ It is with utmost respect and concern that I bring to your attention an issue that I believe requires consideration in the spirit of our country's journey towards complete autonomy. As we celebrate this momentous occasion, it has come to my notice that the [address] of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI), our governing body for cricket, continues to use a logo that is derived from the Star of India emblem, designed during the British Raj in 1928. This emblem bears an alarming resemblance, approximately 90%, to the Star of India. Its use by the BCCI has been criticized by some as a symbol of colonialism.
⏎ Considering your call, which you delivered at the Red Fort on the occasion of 15th August, to move away from the colonial mindset and foster a sense of national identity, I find it perplexing that the BCCI persists in using a logo associated with our colonial past. It is disheartening to see that an institution as significant and influential as the BCCI, which represents the spirit and passion of Indian cricket, does not have its own distinctive logo that encapsulates our rich heritage and diverse culture.
⏎ In recent times, we have witnessed commendable steps taken by the Indian Navy with the introduction of the new Ensign 'Nishaan,' inspired by the illustrious Maratha warrior king, Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj. This move has instilled a sense of national pride and identity within our naval forces. Similarly, I believe it is high time for the BCCI to adopt a logo that is unique to our nation, representing the values, glory, and achievements of Indian cricket.
⏎ I kindly request your esteemed office to address this matter and initiate a process to develop a distinct logo for the BCCI that reflects the spirit of our great nation. Such a logo would symbolize our independence, diversity, and the relentless pursuit of excellence that characterizes Indian cricket.
⏎ I have full confidence in the government's commitment to promoting national unity and pride. By taking this step towards establishing a new logo for the BCCI, we would not only align with the ideals of our Azadika Amrit Mahotsav but also inspire future generations to uphold our rich heritage.
⏎ Thank you for your attention to this matter. I express my heartfelt appreciation for your continuous efforts towards building a stronger, more prosperous, and self-reliant India.
⏎ With sincere regards,
⏎ [name] [name],
Rajkot - [number]

विषय- कुराश के एशियन गेम्स की चयन प्रतियोगिता में फिर दोबारा से रचे जा रहे षड्यंत्र के सम्बंध में
आदरणीय महोदय,
मैं सोमबीर हरियाणा कुराश एसोसिएशन का सचिव हूं और हरियाणा कुराश एसोसिएशन को हरियाणा ओलम्पिक एसोसिएशन व हरियाणा खेल विभाग से मान्यता मिली हुई है जिससे सम्बन्धित दस्तावेज मैं साथ में संलग्न कर रहा हूं ।
आदरणीय महोदय हम हैरान हैं ये जानकर की श्री जगदीश टाईटलर जी के निर्देश पर हरियाणा की एक फर्जी कुराश एसोसिएशन द्वारा हरियाणा मे एशियन गेम्स के लिए कुराश खिलाड़ियों का चयन दिनांक 9 जुलाई को कराया जाना तय हुआ है जबकि हरियाणा में केवल हमारी हरियाणा कुराश एसोसिएशन को ओलम्पिक संघ व खेल विभाग से मान्यता मिली हुई है और हमारा इस फर्जी कुराश एसोसिएशन से कोई सम्बन्ध नहीं है ।
महोदय ये फर्जी एसोसिएशन के साथ मिलकर ऐसा केवल इसलिए कर रहे है जिससे दोबारा फिर से अपने मन मुताबिक बेईमानी कर खिलाड़ियों का चयन किया जा सके और कोई विरोध ना हो ।
महोदय आपको अवगत कराना चाहता हूं की ये लोग लालच में डूब चुके है और अब ये एशियन गेम्स की चयन प्रतियोगिता को सही तरह से नही करा सकते है इसलिए इस तरह के षड्यंत्र रच रहे है ।
आदरणीय महोदय मैं विनम्र पूर्वक यह भी अवगत कराना चाहता हूं कि भारतीय खेल प्राधिकरण में दो जूडो प्रशिक्षक है जो कुराश खेल के विशेषज्ञ है जिनमे से एक पिछले एशियन गेम्स 2018 में कुराश टीम की प्रशिक्षक बनकर गई थी दूसरी कुराश की राष्ट्रीय निर्णायक है दोनो ही दिल्ली में कार्यरत है और निष्पक्ष है ।
अत: आपसे मेरा विनम्र निवेदन है कि इस पूरे ट्रायल में एसोसिएशन की दखलअंदाजी खतम कर भारतीय खेल प्राधिकरण द्वारा कराने की कृपा करे जिससे खिलाड़ियों के भविष्य को बर्बाद होने से बचाया जा सके ।
धन्यवाद ।
⏎ सोमबीर
सचिव
हरियाणा कुराश एसोसिएशन

कई लोगों के लिए, खेल और व्यायाम उनके रोजमर्रा के जीवन का हिस्सा हैं और लंबे और स्वस्थ जीवन की कुंजी हैं। हालाँकि, कई अन्य लोग गतिहीन होते हैं, और बच्चों में दैनिक शारीरिक गतिविधि का स्तर भी लगातार कम हो रहा है। हमारी दुनिया में निरंतर परिवर्तन की स्थिति है, विशेष रूप से तकनीकी प्रगति, जो इस समस्या का कारण है। फिर भी यह प्रक्रिया मौजूदा परिस्थितियों और आज जिस तरह से हम सह-अस्तित्व में हैं और एक-दूसरे के साथ बातचीत करते हैं, उससे भी प्रभावित होती है। चूँकि शारीरिक गतिविधि की कमी व्यक्ति के स्वास्थ्य संबंधी परिणामों से परे, समग्र रूप से समाज के विकास पर भी प्रभाव डाल सकती है, इसलिए इसके खिलाफ कार्रवाई करना महत्वपूर्ण है। हमारे समाज के प्रत्येक सदस्य को अधिक व्यायाम करने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करने के लिए, न केवल निजी या क्लब स्तर पर खेल गतिविधियों की एक विस्तृत श्रृंखला होनी चाहिए, बल्कि लोगों के घरों के करीब एक ऐसा वातावरण भी होना चाहिए जो उन्हें इसमें शामिल होने के लिए प्रेरित और प्रोत्साहित करे। शारीरिक गतिविधि। इसका मतलब यह है कि हमारे शहरों और नगर पालिकाओं को खेल और गतिविधि-अनुकूल बनाया जाना चाहिए।हम आशा करते हैं आप हमारे इस विषय पर ध्यान देंगे और हमरे शहर में एक स्पोर्ट्स कॉम्प्लेक्स बनवाएंगे जिसे हमरे उच्च सत्र पर कार्य कर सकें

MINPA/E/2023/0001120.d: Existing "Sports Signal Act-2007(mandatory sharing with prasar bharati)" restricts only for limited viewers. Current Sports Signal Act(mandatory sharing with prasar bharati)creates partiality in our country. We don't need partiality Act in the parliament. Sports of National importance should be available for every citizens of our country on any platform but this Act creates partiality and restricts for limited viewers but Government doesn't take it seriously since 2017 when supreme court decision made this "Sports Signal Act 2007" powerless.
MINPA/E/2023/0001120.r:
Hon’ble Supreme Court vide its Order dated 22.08.2017 in the matter of Union of India vs. Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) & Ors. Upheld the Order of the Hon’ble high Court of Delhi and held that the content of the live feed received by Prasar Bharati from content rights owners or holders under the Sports Broadcasting Signals (Mandatory Sharing with Prasar Bharati) Act, 2007 (Sports Act) is only for the purpose of re-transmission of the said signals on its own terrestrial and DTH networks and not to any other entities.
⏎ As an effect of the aforesaid order, all the cable operators, DTH Operators are restricted to carry/distribute any channel of Doordarshan during the period it telecasts any matches where the live feed of such matches has been shared by any broadcaster under the Sports Act. However, you can watch all the sporting events without any interruption on DD free Dish.

⏎ I am [name], a journalist with over 25 years of experience in the profession. I earned my spurs and my reputation during my run as the National Sports Editor of The Times of India from 2001 to 2016. (Attachment No. 1: BVK Company Profile)
⏎ I am writing this note to you, Esteemed Sir, with respect to a sports project (36th National Games) that I successfully executed for the Government of Gujarat a few months back.
⏎ My company, BVK Sports and Media managed the entire PR and Social Media exercise, giving wide coverage to the Games and playing a small role in the party winning the Assembly Elections that followed.
⏎ To outline our task, I hired a team of nearly 100 professionals and executed the project with élan. We generated more than 250 press releases, interviews and human-interest stories in a short span of about a month and got most of them published in literally every newspaper in the country.
⏎ I created a huge buzz in Social Media too for the Games, producing captivating Posts, Reels and Videos for Instagram, Twitter, Facebook and YouTube on a real-team basis. I had close to 25 photographers and videographers, in addition to the content team, spread across every stadia in eight cities of Gujarat and Delhi, capturing the glorious moments in each of the 36 sports disciplines.
⏎ Respected Sir, despite all this, despite our brilliant performance, it hurts to bring to your notice that I am being paid only about 50% of the fee that I had been contracted for. In real terms, out of the Rs 1.65 crore that I was to receive for my experience and expertise, I have received only Rs 82,94,000. The cruel part is the contract allows for a maximum deduction of 10% of the contract value if I had fallen short on any count.
⏎ Sir, this is not only grossly unfair and unjust but has also pushed me to the brink of bankruptcy. I had no choice but to sell my flat to raise funds to pay my team who had worked passionately and tirelessly for 30 days and 30 nights.

⏎ Sir, may I humbly request you to consider my grave situation and help me so that I don’t become a victim of official apathy and fall by the wayside. I shall remain forever grateful to you.
⏎ Thanking you,
⏎ Your Sincerely.

PMOPG/E/2023/0165337.d:
Sports >> Special Cash Awards to medal winners in International events and their coaches.
⏎ -----------------------
Dear Honourable Prime Minister,
⏎ I would like to inform you that my children(Aadith and Aadirai) have won the Racketlon World Championship 2023.
⏎ Racketlon is a combination sport for Racket Sports on the lines of Decathlon and Pentathlon. Every match has 4 sets for 21 points and each set is a different sport - Table Tennis, Badminton, Squash, Tennis in the same order. Whoever scores most points is the winner. It’s quite a challenging multi-disciplinary sport and governed by FIR (Federation Internationale de Racketlon, headquartered in Switzerland).
⏎ This year 30 countries (incl. all the G-8 Countries) participated in Racketlon World Championship 2023 held at London, UK and Rotterdam, Netherlands. Aadith and Aadirai together won 5 Medals(3 Gold, 1 Silver, 1 Bronze) in the event and really made our Nation proud at the International event. Aadirai was praised to be a future-star in the making by the President of Federation Internationale de Racketlon during the medal ceremony.
⏎ As Racketlon London Open was held when we were in Europe we used the opportunity to win another Gold medal for our country in U21 event.
⏎ Aadith and Aadirai’s achievements in 2023 World Championship:
* 3 GOLD in Girls U16, U18 and U16 doubles
* SILVER in Mixed doubles U18
* BRONZE in Teams U18
⏎ The Hindu coverage:
www.thehindu.com/sport/other-sports/world-racketlon-aadirai-strikes-the-goldmine-again/[id].ece/amp/
⏎ My children Aadith and Aadirai would like to receive the blessings of our beloved Prime Minister and the Sports Minister. They would like to show the medals to the Prime Minister and Sports Minister.
⏎ We feel, as a nation, we should not be left behind other nations in this sport as it could well become an Olympic Sport in the near future and its modelled on the lines of Decathlon and Pentathlon, which are already part of Olympics.
⏎ Eagerly awaiting your consideration and appointment.
⏎ With utmost respect and gratitude,
K.[name],
Coimbatore,
Tamilnadu.
PMOPG/E/2023/0165337.r: Sir, as per scheme of Cash Awards to medal winners in International sports events and their coaches, the sports disciplines in Olympic Games/ Asian Games/ Commonwealth Games, Chess and Billiards & Snooker are eligible sports disciplines for giving cash awards. The scheme may be seen at Ministry website www.yas.nic.in

Respected sir,
⏎ I am K [name] from Kerala. I write this to draw your kind attention to the significant negligence of excluding the sports event 'Yoga' from the weightage list of Kerala Public Services Commission Examinations and to request you to make a necessary decision on the issue addressed above.
As you are aware, Yoga is a discipline that is gaining prominence across the globe, and the length and breadth of the country with each passing day. The Government of India has entitled the meditative practice as a sports event, bestowing acceptance in physical education realm. Further understanding the health benefits of Yoga, the Central Government has suggested the inclusion of a Yoga Instructor in all schools in National Education Policy 2020. Kerala Government has also appointed Yoga Instructors in many AYUSH dispensaries welcoming the fresh wave of the importance of the ancient practice to build a healthy society. Following the increased limelight on Yoga and its opportunities, the youth has pursued its path through education provided in Central Universities of India and other institutes enrolling in Bachelors and Masters in yoga apart from research. SRC has also undertaken the mission to provide short course on the subject.
However, it's disappointing to indicate that Yoga has been regretfully neglected by the Kerala PSC examinations in permitting grace marks while it allows 40 other sports events in its weightage list. I humbly request you consider the significance of Yoga in the current climate of events and take necessary action to accomodate Yoga in the weightage list of Kerala PSC, lest it take away the deserved chances of the pupil who rightly earns.
Hope you would understand the concern and will look into the matter earliest.
⏎ Thanking you
[name]
K [name]

My kids are dedicated Taekwondo athletes deeply concerned about recent developments in our sport.
⏎ Behalf of my kids I've personally witnessed instances where match outcomes seem influenced by factors other than athletes' performances. This raises serious questions about fairness and transparency in decision-making and it is observed mostly when Mr. [name] is taking charge with their group of Referees from Delhi Taekwondo Association in almost every event.
⏎ Reported Event: 39th Delhi State Taekwondo Championship 2023 organized by Delhi Taekwondo Association.
⏎ I urge prompt attention to the following issues:
⏎ 1. Questionable Decisions: Referees' and judges' calls often appear disconnected from actual performances, casting doubt on the integrity of outcomes.
2. Lack of Accountability: Biased decisions seem unchecked, damaging both athletes' efforts and Taekwondo's reputation.
3. Transparent Oversight: Establishing a transparent officiating system and investigating corruption allegations can restore trust.
4. Enhanced Training: Ongoing education for officials should emphasize both technical expertise and ethical conduct.
5. Most important: A decision-making unit shouldn't be a part of any Taekwondo academy to prevent partiality.

ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಸಬ್ ಜೂನಿಯರ್ ಮತ್ತು ಜೂನಿಯರ್ ಹಾಗೂ ಸೀನಿಯರ್ ಮಹಿಳಾ ಕ್ರೀಡಾಪಟುಗಳಿಗೆ (ಕ್ಯಾಟಗರಿಗಳಿಗೆ) ಎಲ್ಲಾ ತೂಕದ ಕ್ರೀಡಾಪಟುಗಳಿಗೂ (ಕ್ಯಾಟಗರಿಗೂ) ಸ್ಪರ್ಧಿಸಲು ಅವಕಾಶ ಕಲ್ಪಿಸಿರುತ್ತೀರಿ ಆದರೆ ಮಹಿಳಾ ಯೂತ್ ಕ್ರೀಡಾಪಟುಗಳಿಗೆ ( ಕ್ಯಾಟಗಿರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ) 60kg ಗಿಂತ ಅಧಿಕವಾಗಿರುವವರಿಗೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಅವಕಾಶ ಕಲ್ಪಿಸಿರುತ್ತೀರಿ ಇನ್ನುಳಿದ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ತೂಕದ ಕ್ಯಾಟಗರಿಗಳಿಗೂ ಅವಕಾಶ ಕಲ್ಪಿಸಿಲ್ಲ ಇದರಲ್ಲಿ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ WUSHU ಚಾಂಪಿಯನ್ಶಿಪ್ ನಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾಗವಹಿಸಿದ ಕ್ರೀಡಾಪಟುಗಳು ಸಹ ಇದ್ದಾರೆ. ಆದುದರಿಂದ ಯೂಥ್ ಕ್ಯಾಟಗಿಯ ಉಳಿದ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ತೂಕದ ಮಹಿಳಾ ಕ್ರೀಡಾಪಟುಗಳು ಅವಕಾಶ ವಂಚಿತರಾಗುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಯೂತ್ ಕ್ಯಾಟಗರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಆಡುವ ಹೆಣ್ಣು ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಸುಮಾರು 17 ವರ್ಷದವರಾಗಿರುತ್ತಾರೆ ಇವರೆಲ್ಲರೂ ಸೆಕೆಂಡ್ ಪಿಯುಸಿ ವ್ಯಾಸಂಗ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿರುತ್ತಾರೆ ಈ ಸಂದರ್ಭದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಅವಕಾಶ ದೊರಕಿಸಿಕೊಟ್ಟಿದ್ದರೆ, ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರಮಟ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಪದಕಗಳನ್ನು ಪಡೆದುಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದರೆ ಮುಂದಿನ ಉನ್ನತ ವ್ಯಾಸಂಗಕ್ಕೆ ಬಹಳ ಅನುಕೂಲವಾಗುತ್ತಿತ್ತು. ಉದಾಹರಣೆಗೆ ಇಂಜಿನಿಯರಿಂಗ್, ಡಾಕ್ಟರ್ ಇತ್ಯಾದಿ ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ಗಳಿಗೆ ಬಹಳ ಅನುಕೂಲವಾಗುತ್ತಿತ್ತು,ಆದರೆ ತಾವು ಯೂಥ್ ಕ್ಯಾಟಗರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ 60 ಕೆಜಿಗಿಂತ ಮೇಲ್ಪಟ್ಟ ಮಹಿಳಾ ಕ್ರೀಡಾಪಟುಗಳು ಮಾತ್ರ ಸ್ಪರ್ಧಿಸಲು ಅವಕಾಶ ಕಲ್ಪಿಸಿರುವುದರಿಂದ ಉಳಿದ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ತೂಕದ ಕ್ಯಾಟಗಿರಿಯವರು ಅವಕಾಶ ವಂಚಿತರಾಗುತ್ತಾರೆ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ಸಂಬಂಧಪಟ್ಟವರು ಇದನ್ನು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ ಇನ್ನು ಎರಡು ದಿನದಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆಯುವ ವುಶು (WUSHU SPORTS) ಖೇಲೋ ಇಂಡಿಯಾ ವುಮೆನ್ಸ್ ಲೀಗ್ ಸ್ಪರ್ಧೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಯೂಥ್ ಕ್ಯಾಟಗಿರಿಯ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ತೂಕದ ಹೆಣ್ಣು ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೂ ಸ್ಪರ್ಧಿಸಲು ಅವಕಾಶ ಕಲ್ಪಿಸಿ ಕೊಡಬೇಕಾಗಿ ಹಾಗೂ ಈ ಹಂತದ ಕ್ರೀಡಾಪಟುಗಳ ಉಜ್ವಲ ಭವಿಷ್ಯಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಸಹಕರಿಸಬೇಕಾಗಿ ಈ ಮೂಲಕ ಬೇಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತೇವೆ.
ವಂದನೆಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ,

⏎ Sir,
ഞാൻ കഴിഞ്ഞ വർഷം 2022 നവംബർ 3 ന് തിരുവനന്തപുരത്തുവെച്ച് നടന്ന സ്റ്റേറ്റ് ലവൽ ഖേലോ ഇന്ത്യ ബോക്സിങ് പരിശീലന കേന്ദ്രത്തിലേക്ക് പരിശീലകരെ നിയമിക്കുന്നതുമായി ബന്ധപ്പെട്ട് ഇന്റർവ്യൂയിൽ പങ്കെടുക്കുകയുണ്ടായി. ഞാൻ 1 തവണ ദേശീയ ഗെയിംസിലും, 5 തവണ ദേശീയ മത്സരത്തിലുംകേരളത്തെ പ്രതിനിധികരിച്ചു പങ്കെടുത്തിട്ടുണ്ട് ,അതുകൂടാതെ സൗത്ത് സോൺ സീനിയർ ചാമ്പ്യൻഷിപ്പിൽ വെങ്കല മെഡലും നേടിയിട്ടുള്ളതാണ്. 8 തവണ ഞാൻ സംസ്ഥാന ചാമ്പ്യനും ആയിട്ടുണ്ട്. ഈ സർട്ടിഫിക്കറ്റുകളെല്ലാം തന്നെ ഇന്റർവ്യൂ നടക്കുമ്പോൾ സമർപ്പിച്ചിട്ടുള്ളതുമാണ്.എന്നാൽ ഇദ്ദേഹം സംസ്ഥാന ചാമ്പ്യൻ ഷിപ്പിൽ 1 തവണ പോലും ചാമ്പ്യൻ ആയിട്ടില്ല. രണ്ടാം സ്ഥാനം വന്നിട്ടാണ് 1 തവണ മാത്രം ദേശീയ ഗെയിംസ് മാത്രം പങ്കെടുത്തിട്ടുള്ളത്, ശ്രീ പ്രബീഷ് എന്ന വ്യക്തിയെ മേൽ പറഞ്ഞ തസ്തികയിലേക്ക് നിയമിച്ചിട്ടുള്ളതായി അറിയാൻ കഴിഞ്ഞു. കഴിവുള്ളവരെ സെലക്ട്‌ ചെയ്യാതെ നേട്ടങ്ങൾ കുറവുള്ളവരെ നിയമിച്ച ഈ പ്രവണത നീതി നിഷേധമാണ്. കേരള സ്പോർട്സ് കൌൺസിൽ ഈ ജോലി കൊടുത്തിരിക്കുന്നത് അവിടുത്തെ കമ്മറ്റിയിലെ അംഗത്തിന്റ സുഹൃത്തിനാണ്. വിവരാവകാശം കൊടുത്തിട്ട് അവർ മറുപടി തന്നിട്ടില്ലായിരുന്നു. അതിന്റെ അടിസ്ഥാനത്തിൽ കേരള സ്പോർട്സ് കൌൺസിൽ SPIO ക്ക് 1000 രൂപ മാത്രം പിഴ അടക്കാൻ ഉത്തരവായിരുന്നു. ഒരു കേസ് കൊടുക്കാനുള്ള സാമ്പത്തിക സ്ഥിതി എനിക്കില്ല. 2പേർക്കും കിട്ടിയ സർട്ടിഫിക്കറ്റ് കോപ്പി, മാർക്ക്‌ ഷീറ്റ് ഇതോടൊപ്പം ഫയൽ ചെയ്യുന്നു.

પરમ શ્રધ્યેય, પરમ આદરણીય ગુજરાતનાં ગૌરવ અને અખંડ ભારતના યશસ્વી વડાપ્રધાન શ્રી. શ્રી નરેન્દ્રભાઇ મોદી સાહેબને કોટી કોટી વંદન. આપનો યશ દશે દિશાઓમાં અવિરત પણે વધતો રહે અને આપના સફળ નેતૃત્વમાં ભારત દેશ સફળતાના તમામ સોપાનો સર કરી સમૃદ્ધિ પામે અને મહાસત્તા બને એવી પરમ કૃપાળુ પરમાત્માના ચરણોમાં પ્રાર્થના. મારુ નામ નરેન્દ્રસિંહ આર. ક્ષત્રિય છે. હૂં વ્યવસાયે એક શારીરિક શિક્ષણનો અધ્યાપક છું. પૂરી વિનમ્રતા અને આપને વંદન કરીને વંદે માતરમ સહ આપને મારી એક સમસ્યા વર્ણવું છું. હાલ માજ પૂર્ણ થયેલી વર્લ્ડ યુનિવર્સિટી ગેમ્સમાં આપણાં દેશવતી એકમાત્ર એફ. આઈ. વી. બી આંતર રાષ્ટ્રીય વોલીબોલ રેફ્રી તરીકે FIVB દ્વારા મારી નિમણૂક કરવામાં આવી હતી. અને મને આપણાં દેશનું પ્રતિનિધિત્વ કરવાનું ગૌરવ પ્રાપ્ત થયું હતું. આગામી ૧૯મી સપ્ટેમ્બરથી સારું થતાં ૧૯ માં એશિયન ગેમ્સમાં મારી નિમણૂક એશિયન વોલીબોલ કનફઈડ્રેશન દ્વારા કરવામાં આવી છે. હાલમાં વોલીબોલ ફેડરેશન ઓફ ઈન્ડિયા અસ્તિત્વમાં નથી અને આપણાં દેશમાં વૉલીબોલ રમતનું સંચાલન હાલ એડહોક કમિટી- વોલીબોલ ફેડરેશન ઓફ ઈન્ડિયા દ્વારા કરવામાં આવી રહ્યું છે. એડહોક કમિટી- વોલીબોલ ફેડરેશન ઓફ ઈન્ડિયા દ્વારા ૫મી ઓગસ્ટના રોજ એશિયન વોલીબોલ કનફીડ્રેશનને ઈમેલ કરીને મારી નિમણૂકને અસ્વીકૃત કરી હતી અને મારા સ્થાને બીજા આંતર રાષ્ટ્રીય વોલીબોલ રેફ્રીની ભલામણ કરવામાં આવી હતી જેનો AVC દ્વારા ગમે તે કારણોસર અસ્વીકાર કરવામાં આવ્યો હતો. સાહેબશ્રી મારી નિમણૂક એશિયન ગેમ્સ માટે ૩૧ મે, ૨૦૨૩ ના રોજ થઈ હતી ત્યારે એડહોક કમિટી- વોલીબોલ ફેડરેશન ઓફ ઈન્ડિયા અસ્તિત્વમાં જ નહોતુ. આજે મારી એફ. આઈ. વી. બી આંતર રાષ્ટ્રીય વોલીબોલ રેફ્રી તરીકેની કારકિર્દી અકાળે અંતના આરે છે ત્યારે એડહોક કમિટી- વોલીબોલ ફેડરેશન ઓફ ઈન્ડિયા દ્વારા એશિયન વોલીબોલ કનફીડ્રેશનને ઈમેલ કરીને મારી નિમણૂકને સ્વીકૃતી મળે એવી હૂ આપશ્રીની પાસે મદદની અપેક્ષા રાખું છું. જો આપના આશીર્વાદ અને પ્રયત્નોથી એશિયન ગેમ્સમાં મારી નિમણૂક યથાવત રહશે તો હૂં અને મારો પૂરો પરિવાર આજીવન આપના ઋણી રહીશું. આપશ્રીના માર્ગદર્શન અને આદેશને આજીવન માથે ચઢાવીશ એ વાતની હૂ આપશ્રીને ખાતરી આપું છું. આપનો યશ સમગ્ર વિશ્વમાં વ્યાપે આપનો સુર્ય સદાયકાલ માટે મધ્યાહ્ને તપતો રહે એજ પરમ કૃપાળુ પરમાત્માને પ્રાર્થના.આપના ચરણોમાં વંદન, જય જય ગરવી ગુજરાત, ભારત માતા કી જય.

⏎ विषय: आगामी एशियाई खेल 2023 के लिए भारतीय महिला कबड्डी टीम की अनियमितताओं के संदर्भ में।
महोदय,
नम्रतापूर्वक अनुरोध है कि, मैं आगामी एशियाई खेलों के लिए पिछले चार वर्षों से लगातार, बिना एक भी दिन की कोचिंग छोड़े, पूरी ईमानदारी और समर्पण के साथ भारतीय महिला कबड्डी टीम को कोचिंग दे रही थी। लेकिन अचानक दिनांक 14.07.23 को कैम्प के बीच में ही मेरी सेवाएँ वापस ले ली गयीं, 15.07.23 ओलम्पिक एसोसिएशन को नाम भेजने की अंतिम तिथि थी। हटाने से पहले कोई आरोप मुझसे साझा नहीं किया गया, न ही अपनी बात कहने का कभी कोई अवसर दिया गया। बाद में मुझे पता चला कि साई गांधीनगर से कैम्प कोआर्डिनेटर जयवीर शर्मा की कोई दुर्भावनापूर्ण, अतथ्यातमक, आधारहीन रिपोर्ट जिसमें हम दो कोचो की तथाकथित आपसी लड़ाई को पेश किया गया है। उल्लेखनीय है कि यह रिपोर्ट भी कभी हमसे साझा नहीं की गई, हमारा पक्ष नहीं सुना गया।
हैरानी की बात यह है कि कबड्डी फेडरेशन द्वारा दो नए कोचों के नाम, उनके टीम के साथ शामिल हुए बिना और एक भी दिन कोचिंग दिए बिना ही भेज दिए गए। यह मानना तार्किक होगा कि मेरी सेवाओं को समाप्त करने के बाद अपने निर्णय को सही साबित करने के लिए ज्यादातर दस्तावेज तैयार किए गए हैं क्योंकि उससे पहले कोई भी दस्तावेज मुझे मुहैया नहीं कराया गया। बाद में मुझे पता चला कि दो कोचो की आपसी लड़ाई को आधार बनाया गया है, जबकि वास्तविकता यह है कि मैं कभी किसी लड़ाई का हिस्सा नहीं रही, एक दिन दूसरी महिला कोच ने बिना किसी कारण मेरे ऊपर चिल्लाना शुरू कर दिया , मैं उसको " यहां बच्चों के सामने नहीं रूम पर चलकर बात करते हैं" इतना कह कर वहां से बाहर निकल आई। इस घटना को वहां के CCTV रिकॉर्डिंग्स से सत्यापित किया जा सकता है। इसके बाद बात आई गई हो गयी, अगला कैम्प शुरू हो गया, लगभग एक महीने बाद इस मामूली बात को बढ़ा चढ़ा कर, रस्सी को सांप कर, बिना हमारा पक्ष जाने यह अन्यायपूर्ण देशघाती निर्णय लिया गया।
वास्तविकता यह है कि नवनियुक्त कोचों में आये दिन लड़ाई होती रहती है तथा इस अत्यंत महत्वपूर्ण समय पर पिछले चार-पांच सेशन से भारतीय टीम प्रैक्टिस नहीं कर रही है। इसको महोदय सत्यापित करवा सकते हैं।
महोदय, तथ्य यह हैं कि यह जयवीर शर्मा तथा नवनियुक्त साई कोच कविता स्वयं बच्चो के

To
⏎ Secretary (Coordination)
DDA Sports Wing
⏎ Subject: Ref: No. F8221)SW/Coordn./2021/DDA/5Ч4 dated September 29, 2023
⏎ Dear Sir,
⏎ In line with the 'Khelo India' initiative promoted by the Government of India, we were surprised to receive Circular No. F8221)SW/Coordn./2021/DDA/5Ч4 dated September 29, 2023, which imposes a charge of Rs 75 per 40-minute slot for playing table tennis, regardless of the player's membership status. We strongly oppose this circular and kindly request its immediate withdrawal based on the following grounds:
⏎ 1.In addition to the one-time life membership fee, members are already subject to an annual fee for utilizing the facilities within the complex. There appears to be no justification for introducing additional charges for playing table tennis within the complex, which are in addition to the life membership and existing annual fee.
⏎ 2.The rationale behind charging the same fee for a fixed time-slot to both members and non-members raises questions about the purpose of becoming a 'member.' This decision seems to lack careful consideration and evaluation.
⏎ 3.What is particularly concerning is the absence of prior consultation with the members before issuing this unilateral circular. The DDA Sports Complex operates on a membership basis, and major decisions like this should ideally have the consensus of the majority, in line with the democratic principles of our nation.
⏎ 4.DDA Sports Facilities were established to foster a healthy sports environment. This circular appears to contradict the very ethos of promoting sports and may have the unintended consequence of discouraging participation.
⏎ We are unified in our determination to oppose this circular and earnestly request the DDA Sports Wing to withdraw this proposal immediately.
⏎ Yours sincerely,
⏎ The Members

⏎ सविनय निवेदन है कि मैं सुजीत कापर ग्राम पोस्ट कुआरी मदन वार्ड नम्बर 03 थाना मेजरगँज जिला सीतामढी बिहार का निवासी हुॅ। मै आपका ध्यान वथनाहा विधान सभा की और आकृष्टि करना चाहता हुॅ। जैसा कि आपको पता ही है कि मेजरगँज प्रखँद मे प्रस्तावित खेल मैदान कि कोई वयवस्था नहीं है। खेल मैदान के अभाव मे युवा जो कि देस की रक्षा के लिए सेना मे भर्ती होने की जजबा रखते हैं उन युवा पीढ़ी बच्चों/छोटे बङे भाईयों को सेना मे भर्ती के लिए दौङ लगाने एवँ खेल कुद के लिए जिला मुख्यालय मे जाना पङता है। सबसे दुरभाग यह है कि कई भाईयों जो जिला मुख्यालय रहने मे असमक्षम है वह सभी ग्राम सङक पर दौङ लगाने के लिए मजबूर है। जिससे कि हमेशा कुछ अनहोनी धटनाय की अशँका बनी रहती है। माननीय विधायक जी आपको सूचित करना चाहता हुॅ कि हमारे मेजरगँज प्रखँद मे कई सँखया मे बच्चों और हमारे छोता और बङे भाई है जो बहुत कमजोर वर्ग से आते हैं । सेना के भर्ती के लिए एवँ दौर लगाने के लिए जिला मुख्यालय मे रहना उन सभी के लिए असकछम है जिसके कारण उन सभी जो सेना मे जाने के लिए सपना रखते हैं वह सपना ही रह जाता है एक ही है कारण कि हमारे मेजरगँज प्रखँद स्तर पर मैदान नहीं है। एक तरफ बिहार सरकार हो या केन्द्र की सरकार हो खेल और उससे जुड़े सेना मे भर्ती होने के प्रोत्साहन दे रही है। वही सीतामढी के मेजरगँज प्रखँद मे खेल मैदान नहीं होने के कारन युवा पीढ़ी अपने आप को असहज महसूस कर रहे है। प्रखँद मे युवा को खेल मैदान की सुविधा दिया जाए तो मेजरगँज के 8 पँचायतो के बच्चों अपनी प्रतिभा मे बेहतर निखार ला सकते है। बच्चों के संपूर्ण विकास के लिए खेलना भी उतना ही आवश्यक है जितना कि पढ़ना। यदि आपने बच्चों और युवा पीढ़ी के हित को ध्यान में रखते हुए खेल के मैदान की व्यवस्था करवाई तो हम सभी छात्र गारजियन आपके सदा आभारी रहेंगे। मेरे द्वारा सीतामढी जिलाअन्तगर्त मेजरगँज प्रखँद मे तथाकथित बिहार सरकार के किसी खाली जमीन को खेल के मैदान निर्माण के लिए आवँटित करने का अनुरोध किया गया

हैं सिर्फ़ उन खिलाडियों को छोड़कर जो इस मैच में शामिल नहीं थे और इस और इस platform पर तो captain और vice captain का तो 2x aur 1.5x point मिलता हैं और मेरे द्वारा चुने गए captain और vice captain ही इस मैच में नहीं थे जिस कारण मेरे points कम हुए लेकिन यदि उन खिलाडियों का एक औसत भी जोड़ दिया जाए तो मेरी जीत सुनिश्चित थी और मेरी द्वारा जीती गई पूर्ण राशी जोड़ी जाए तो ₹[number].65 होते और साथ ही दुबई It’s quite a challenging multi-disciplinary sport and governed by FIR (Federation Internationale de Racketlon, headquartered in Switzerland).

Dear Sir Your Excellency Prime Minister of India Hon'ble Narendra Modi,
⏎ In a letter I sent to you many years ago, I wrote about the importance of adding Yoga to cricket coaching. I wrote about a brain wave thought that sports can be spiritual as much as it is physical. I asked you to give all the team members of all of India's national teams good training in Yoga at Sadhguru's Isha Foundation, based in Coimbatore, India. India and Sri [name] are ancient countries with thousands of years of track record in spiritual-based training in arts such as this, and players must add spiritual training to their regular training in any art of sport.
⏎ I got another brainwave idea about training in cricket and that is Karate Kata. When I was learning karate, the class was taught that kata is a Japanese word for 'heart' and karate kata means the 'heart of karate.' I Googled 'karate kata' and got the result, "Kata is a Japanese word describing detailed patterns of movements practised either solo or in pairs. Karate kata is executed as a specified series of a variety of moves, with stepping and turning, while attempting to maintain perfect form in karate."
⏎ I was just wondering if this can be applied to cricket by developing a series of patterns of movements executed as a specified series of a variety of moves in batting, bowling, and fielding, practised individually or with the team, while at the same time attempting to maintain perfect form in cricket. This cricket kata, varying from individual to individual, can be described as the 'heart of cricket.'
⏎ If you have seen a red-belt Japanese Karate Grandmaster and observed the form he is in, that is the form India's national cricket team members could have. My first theory that sports can be spiritual as much as it is physical will still remain high here. This is a good way India can take cricket to Japan and the rest of Asia, and Japan after winning some matches with other countries, can become a member of the ICC this way.

Respected Prime Minister,

Recent events, particularly our team's performance in the Cricket World Cup, have prompted me to express my thoughts on a unique and potentially transformative approach to cricket training. I deeply appreciated your encouraging words to the players after our recent loss in the Cricket World Cup. It was evident that you understand the importance of mental toughness in sports, an aspect that can often be the differentiator between victory and defeat. With this in mind, I would like to propose an innovative training method that focuses on honing the mental strength of our national cricket team. As you may be aware, success in cricket is not merely about talent but also about the ability to perform under diverse and challenging conditions. I propose a simulated training program where the Indian cricket team engages in practice matches against the four major zonal teams in India. However, to make this training truly transformative, these matches will be played under intentionally disadvantaged conditions. In these simulated matches, our national team will relinquish the right to decide the toss, play on different pitches within the same match, and face various other challenges. The objective is to create an environment where our players must rely on their mental resilience and innovative thinking to secure victory, irrespective of external factors. This approach is inspired by the training methods employed by elite military units, such as the Marines, whose focus is on accomplishing the mission despite adverse circumstances. I firmly believe that this unique training regimen will instill mental toughness in our players that goes beyond conventional methods. I will be honored and happy to discuss the idea if needed with the coaching staff, if they find it useful.
Thanking you for your kind consideration
[name]

सेवा में,
माननीय प्रधानमंत्री महोदय,
भारत सरकार, नई दिल्ली।
विषयः- जिला स्पोर्टस स्टेडियम, सिद्धार्थनगर (उत्तर प्रदेश) का नाम भाजपा के शासनकाल में पूर्व काबीना मंत्री रहे स्व0 धनराज यादव जी के नाम करने के संबंध में।
महोदय,
सादर अवगत कराना है कि उत्तर प्रदेश के सभी जनपदों में जिला स्पोर्टस स्टेडियम का नाम किसी महान व्यक्ति, पुरुष अथवा अन्य विशेष व्यक्तियों के नाम करने का निर्णय लिया गया है। इसी कड़ी में पिछले छह (06) माह पूर्व जिलाधिकारी की अध्यक्षता में गठित जिला खेल विकास एवं प्रोत्साहन समिति की बैठक में प्रस्तावित कई नामों में से एक नाम स्व0 धनराज यादव का भी था। वह जनसंघ काल से वर्ष 2002 के पहले तक सिद्धार्थनगर जिले के सदर विधानसभा सीट कपिलवस्तु (नौगढ़) से विधायक रह चुके हैं। वह माननीय श्री कल्याण सिंह जी, श्री राजनाथ सिंह जी तथा श्री राम प्रकाश गुप्त जी के मंत्रिमंडल में बतौर राज्यमंत्री और कैबिनेट मंत्री रहे हैं।
विश्वस्त सूत्रों के मुताबिक स्व0 धनराज यादव के नाम पर बांसी के विधायक एवं प्रदेश के पूर्व स्वास्थ्य मंत्री श्री जय प्रताप सिंह जी, छह माह पूर्व भाजपा जिलाध्यक्ष रहे, वर्तमान में नगर पालिका परिषद सिद्धार्थनगर के अध्यक्ष (पूर्व मंत्री के पुत्र) श्री गोविंद माधव जी समेत अन्य जनप्रतिनिधियों एवं प्रोत्साहन समिति के कई सदस्यों की ओर से लिखित और मौखिक सहमति जताई जा चुकी है।
बताते चले कि उत्तर प्रदेश के सिद्धार्थनगर जिले में दो वर्ष पूर्व स्वशासी मेडिकल कॉलेज का उद्घाटन देश के यशस्वी प्रधानमंत्री आदरणीय श्री नरेंद्र मोदी जी द्वारा किया गया था। बाद में इस मेडिकल कॉलेज का नाम सिद्धार्थनगर जनपद के बांसी तहसील क्षेत्र के निवासी रहे, जनसंघ एवं भाजपा उत्तर प्रदेश के प्रथम प्रदेश अध्यक्ष स्व. माधव प्रसाद त्रिपाठी जी के नाम से संचालित है। ऐसे में सिद्धार्थनगर जनपद में जिला स्पोर्टस स्टेडियम का नाम सदर विधानसभा क्षेत्र से कई बार विधायक और भाजपा शासनकाल में मंत्री रहे स्व. धनराज यादव जी के नाम से किया जाना न्याय संगत होगा।
अतः श्रीमान जी से निवेदन है कि उत्तर प्रदेश के सिद्धार्थनगर जनपद स्थित जिला स्पोर्टस स्टेडियम का नाम पूर्व मंत्री स्व0 धनराज यादव के नाम करने की दिशा में अपने स्तर से कार्रवाई करने अथवा कराने की कृपा करें।
भवदीय

माननीय प्रधानमंत्री महोदय,भारत
⏎ विषय: देश में खेल विश्वविद्यालय स्थापित ना करने से संबंधित शिकायत पत्र।
विशेष:- शिकायत संख्या MINHA/E/2022/12066, PMOPG/E/2022/0208744 में खेल बढ़ावे को ध्यान पर रखकर कोई कार्यवाही नहीं की गई।
⏎ महोदय
(1) किशोर, युवा, विद्यार्थी के जीवन में खेल का कितना महत्व है और किशोर और युवाओं को खेलना कितना लाभदायक है इसका अंदाजा कोरोना काल में आई अनेकों रिपोर्टों से लगाया जा सकता है।
(2) जिसमें स्पष्ट रूप से कहा गया है कि स्वस्थ रहने के लिए प्रतिरोधक क्षमता का शरीर में होना अत्यधिक लाभदायक होता है।
(3) प्रतिरोधक क्षमता बढ़ाने में शारीरिक श्रम, खेलकद का अत्यधिक महत्व होता है।
(4) इसके लिए जरूरी है की बाल अवस्था और युवावस्था में खेलों के अधिक संसाधन उपलब्ध कराए जाएं।
(5) जिसके लिए आवश्यक है खेलों का शिक्षण, प्रशिक्षण के लिए खेल अध्यापक नियुक्त किए जाएं।
(6) यह तभी संभव है जब खेल विश्वविद्यालय स्थापित हो और युवाओं में खेलों के प्रति अधिक रूचि पैदा हो, शिक्षण प्रशिक्षण मिले और अधिक खेल अध्यापक बनाए जाएं जिसके लिए जरूरी है केंद्र द्वारा खेल विश्वविद्यालय स्थापित करना।
(7) खेल केंद्र का विषय भी है जिस पर केंद्र सही प्रकार से उपयुक्त बजट और संसाधन उपलब्ध नहीं करा रहा हैं और केंद्र खेल विश्वविद्यालय स्थापित नहीं हो पा रहे है।
(8) इससे आने वाले भविष्य में नागरिकों की दिनचर्या में बहुत अधिक प्रतिकूल असर पड़ने की संभावना है जो इंसान के लिए बहुत ही घातक सिद्ध हो सकता है।
(9) विद्यालय में शारीरिक शिक्षा पर कम ध्यान देने के कारण से किशोर और युवावस्था में बहुत अधिक मोटापा बढ़ रहा है।
(10) यह ने वाले समय में महामारी का रूप ले सकता है आदि और भी अनेकों समस्याएं उत्पन्न हो सकती हैं।
(11) इसलिए जरूरी है कि देश में केंद्र खेल विश्वविद्यालय स्थापित हो शिक्षण और प्रशिक्षण की सुविधा देश की आवश्यकता के अनुसार उपलब्ध कराई जाए।
(12) जिससे नागरिकों की सेहत के साथ-सथ देश और संसार में होने वाले खेलों में भारत अधिक से अधिक पदक जीतकर देश का नाम रोशन कर सकें।
(13) उम्मीद है इस पर अनुभूति पूर्वक विचार करके, निर्णय लेकर जल्द देश में खेल विश्वविद्यालय स्थापित करने की कार्य कार्यवाही आरंभ की जाएगी। जवाब की प्रतीक्षा। धन्यवाद सहित।
⏎ हरपाल की चौपाल, कादीपुर

⏎ -----------------------
Honorable Prime Minister,
⏎ I hope this letter finds you in good health and high spirits. I am writing to you as a citizen based in [address], deeply committed to seeing a vibrant sports culture in India. While our nation has made remarkable strides in various sectors, the imposition of an 18% Goods and Services Tax (GST) on sports coaching and playing physical sports is a pressing concern that I believe warrants your immediate attention.
⏎ 1. Inhibition of Private Sector Participation: The current GST rate of 18% on sports infrastructure and coaching is a significant barrier to private investment in world-class sports facilities. The high tax rate discourages entrepreneurs and investors from developing the necessary infrastructure.
⏎ 2. Sports as a Basic Necessity: Physical activity and sports are not just leisure activities but fundamental components of a healthy lifestyle. Classifying sports under the 18% GST bracket severely limits the accessibility and affordability of sports for the masses, contrary to the ethos of sports being a universal right.
⏎ 3. Vision for the 2036 Olympics: With the 2036 Olympics on the horizon, it is imperative for India to lay a robust foundation that promotes sports at every level. Creating an ecosystem that nurtures talent from the grassroots to the international stage is essential for India to excel on such a prestigious platform. This vision can only be realized if we make concerted efforts today to alleviate the financial burdens that currently encumber our sports industry.
⏎ 4. Limited GST Revenue from Sports: The reality of the current tax structure is such that it has inadvertently pushed a significant portion of sports coaching and infrastructure services into the non-GST registered bracket. This not only results in negligible GST revenue from this sector but also hinders the entry of organized entities into the sports industry, thereby stunting its growth and professionalization.

⏎ We have many women sports persons, but our hindu culture stops aspirations of women even though our God is a female - Bhavani. Women generally stop the sports as soon as they get married, or they have to support a family, or they have financial issues.

2. When a woman gets married, she literally stops her sports career. There should be day cares in Gyms, etc that can help a married woman with or without kids to still continue her aspirations.

5. Even today, there are no facilities for practise. I think every village should have at a minimum - Olympic size swimming pool, A proper track & field, A Gym with all the equipment, a park, Tennis courts, soccer field, and a cricket field. IF we don't achieve these, then our sports are not reaching to a common man.
6. Every family in a village want to get their girls married when they reach puberty. Most girls don't even get exposed to any sports or even participate in. There should be a mandatory rule to have a girls team in every school. If there are not many girls, they can participate in boys teams.

इस हारकोर सिख धर्म ब्लैक मैजिक के 18 तरीके को छोड़ो आगर एक मंत्र से पूरी दुनिया में किसी के माउथ से एक बार आवाज सुना दी वो तो गया। सोच लो ब्लैक मैजिक कहते किसे है यह तो हार्डकोर है मजाक मत समझना आप जो भी सोचो जो भगवान ने लिखा है वोही होता है अभी तक के एकड़ मुझे यह बता रहे हैं कि मेने 18,000 से ज्यादा कोर्ट केस दर्ज करे जब भी वो मदर चोद की ओलाद किस गली में छुप कर कला जादू का नंगा नाच दिखा रहा है मेरी तो कबर खोद डाली हाथ की लकीर से उसने बचपन मे आग लगा डाली यह बात भी तुम्हे हाथ की लकीर बताएगी 10,000 से काम नहीं होगी भगवान यह बात जानते हैं मौत तो बचपन मे हो जाती इसी को आंख में तिल बाला इंसान कहते हैं वो पूरी दुनिया में एक है दुनिया बनाने से अभी तक। एक बात झूट लिकल गई तो आग लगा लूंगा 70 लाख से ज्यादा वीडियो देख ली है वो ज़हर पीने से ज्यादा खतरनाक है एहसास भी ऐसा जैसे साप ने हकीकत में निगल लिया भगवान की कसम यह लकीर उनकी है इसलिए जनवरी 2022 से पहले मुझे एक सीन दिखाई नहीं देते थे वो भूतकाल हो या कुछ भी। सरकार में जाकर बैठ गए और कला जादू टोना टोटका रोक तक नहीं पाते। इंटरनेशनल क्रिमिनल कोर्ट में कोर्ट केस की आनुमात होती तो 18,000 कोर्ट केस की जरूरत नहीं होती। एक बार में पूरा केस खत्म हो सकता है।
आज तो कला जादू टोना टोटका में जाकर मिल गया मोहम्मद और टेलर स्विफ्ट रकुल प्रीत उनके साथ मिलकर रात बिता रही है एक मंत्र ने ऐसा आखों में 50 से ज्यादा बार दिखाया। आवाज और एहसास तो स्पर्म डोनर जैसा एक दम हकीकत अरे मालिक आज 5 महीने हो गए इस मोहम्मद और टेलर स्विफ्ट रकुल प्रीत के जहर के ।
PMOPG/E/2024/0039393.r: The matter in not pertains with Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.

மதிப்பிற்குரிய மாண்புமிகு பாரத பிரதமர் அவர்களுக்கு வணக்கம்.
⏎ அய்யா, நம் தேசம் கோடி கணக்கான கிரிக்கெட் ரசிகர்கள் மற்றும் பல லட்சம் இளம் கிரிக்கெட் வீரர்களை கொண்ட தேசம் ஆகும்.
⏎ அய்யா, தற்போது கிரிக்கெட் போட்டிகள் ஆண் மற்றும் பெண் என இரண்டு பாலினத்தவர்கள் மட்டும் விளையாடும் வகையில் உள்ளது. இதோடு கூடுதலாக மூன்றாம் பாலினத்தவர்களுக்கான அணியையும் உருவாக்க வேண்டும் என கேட்டுக் கொள்கிறேன்.
⏎ அதேபோல் மகளிர் கிரிக்கெட்டை மேலும் ஊக்கப்படுத்தும் வகையில் கலப்பு பாலினம் கிரிக்கெட் அணியை உருவாக்க வேண்டும் என கேட்டுக் கொள்கிறேன். அதாவது ஆண்+பெண்+ மாற்று பாலினத்தவர்கள் (5+5+1=11 என்ற விகிதாச்சாரம் அடிப்படையில்) இணைந்து விளையாடும் வகையில் புதிய அணி மற்றும் போட்டி முறைகளை உருவாக்கி விளையாட்டில் பாலின பாகுபாடுகளை களைய வேண்டும் என கேட்டுக் கொள்கிறேன்.
⏎ அய்யா, பல விளையாட்டு போட்டிகள் ஆண் பெண் இணைந்து கலப்பு இரட்டையர்களை கொண்ட அணியாக விளையாடும் போது கிரிக்கெட்டிலும் அதை செயல்படுத்துவது காலத்தில் அவசியம் என நான் கருதுகிறேன்.
⏎ அய்யா, பாலின சமத்துவத்தை நோக்கிய உலகளாவிய பயணத்தில் நம் தேசம் முன்னிலையில் செல்ல இதுபோன்ற செயல்களை முன்னெடுத்து மிகவும் அவசியமானதாகும். அய்யா,எனது இந்த கோரிக்கையை தாங்கள் பரிசிலிக்க நடவடிக்கை எடுக்க வேண்டும் என கேட்டுக் கொள்கிறேன்.
⏎ நன்றி
⏎ இப்படிக்கு
கா.அய்யம்பெருமாள்.

⏎ நான் நைனாமலை, சேலம் கலராம்பட்டியில் வசித்து வருகிறேன். எனது குழந்தைகள் நிஷாந்த் மற்றும் சர்வேஸ்வரன் ஆகியோர் தற்போது சேலம் கேலோ இந்தியா மையத்தில் குத்துச்சண்டை பயிற்சி பெற்று வருகிறார். எங்கள் பயிற்சியாளர் திருமதி ஹேமலதா க, எங்கள் குழந்தைகளுக்கு பயிற்சி அளிப்பதில் சிறப்பான பணியை செய்து வருகிறார். அவர் அவர்களை திறம்பட பயிற்றுவிப்பது மட்டுமல்லாமல், அவர்களிடம் ஒழுக்கத்தையும் மதிப்புகளையும் வளர்க்கிறார். எங்கள் குழந்தைகளின் திறமையை வளர்த்து, அவர்களை வெற்றியை நோக்கி அழைத்துச் செல்வதில் அவர் முக்கிய பங்காற்றியுள்ளார்.
⏎ பயிற்சியின் போது தனியார் குத்துச்சண்டை கிளப் உறுப்பினர்கள் பயிற்சி களத்தை ஆக்கிரமித்து தொந்தரவு செய்தல் உள்ளிட்ட தேவையற்ற இடையூறுகளைத் தவிர, எங்கள் பயிற்சியாளர் திருமதி ஹேமலதா கே, தனியாக இருந்தபோது செங்கல்லால் தாக்கப்பட்ட சம்பவமும் உள்ளது. கூடுதலாக, மேற்படி கிளப்புடன் நெருங்கிய தொடர்புடைய கோபி என்ற பெற்றோர், பயிற்சி அமர்வுகள் மற்றும் ஸ்பாரிங்(Sparing) போட்டிகளின் போது இடையூறுகளை ஏற்படுத்தி வருவது வழக்கம். துரதிர்ஷ்டவசமாக, கோபியின் தவறான புரிதலால், அவர் தனது குழந்தைகளை எங்கள் அணியில் இருந்து விலக்கி, தனியார் கிளப்பில் சேர்ந்தார்.
⏎ மேலும், பயிற்சியின் போது தவறாக வழிநடத்தும் நடைமுறைகள், பெற்றோரின் நிதிச் சுரண்டல் மற்றும் குழந்தைகளை தவறாக நடத்துவதாக கோபி சேலம் முதலமைச்சரின் தனிப்பிரிவில் புகார் அளித்துள்ளார். இந்தக் குற்றச்சாட்டுகள் அனைத்தும் ஆதாரமற்றவை. திருமதி ஹேமலதா கே அவர்கள் தனது பொறுப்புகளை விடாமுயற்சியுடன் மேற்கொண்டு நமது குழந்தைகளின் நலனையும் முன்னேற்றத்தையும் உறுதி செய்து வருகிறார். அவர் கல்வியின் முக்கியத்துவத்தை வலியுறுத்தியும் வருகிறார், ஆக இது விளையாட்டு மற்றும் கல்வியை சமநிலைப்படுத்துவதற்கான அவரது முயற்சிகளில் பிரதிபலிக்கிறது.
⏎ திருமதி ஹேமலதா மீது இந்த ஒரு பொய்யான குற்றசாட்டை முன்வைத்து, இவரை பணி நீக்கம் செய்து, ஆள் மாற்றத்திற்கான பணிகள் நடந்து கொண்டிருக்கிறது. இச்செயலில் நீதி வழங்கப்படுவதையும்,எங்கள் பயிற்சியாளர் செய்த நல்ல பணி அங்கீகரிக்கப்பட்டு பாராட்டப்படுவதையும் உறுதிப்படுத்த இந்த விஷயத்தில் உங்கள் தலையீட்டை நாங்கள் கோருகிறோம்.

However, it is informed that the recruitment against sports quota vacancies in Central Government offices is done in accordance with the instructions of the Department of Personnel and Training dated 03.10.2013, 18.11.2022 and 04.03.2024. Under these instructions, reservation upto 5 percent of direct recruit vacancies in Group C and erstwhile Group D are reserved for meritorious sportsperson. Besides, Sports Authority of India recruits Olympians Paralympians as Assistant Coach i.e entry level grade of Caches. 5 percent of posts at entry level cadre is reserved for olympians and 1 percent for Paralympians. माननीय प्रधानमंत्री महोदय भारत
⏎ विषय - देश मे राष्ट्रीय खेल घोषित ना करने से संबंधित शिकायत पत्र।
विशेष- पूर्व शिकायतों MINHA/E/2022/13484, DARPG/E/2022/31257, MINHA/E/2022/05186, PMOPG/E/2022/0096858, MINHA/E/2022/12066, PMOPG/E/2022/0208744, MINHA/E/2023/0025692, MOPG/E/2021/0590937 पर संज्ञान नहीं लिए गया.
महोदय,
(1) देश के अपने महत्वपूर्ण चिन्ह खेल घोषित होते हैं। जैसे हमारा राष्ट्रगान, ध्वज, प्रतिक, पशु, पक्षी, राष्ट्रीय पिता महात्मा गाँधी आदि अनेकों प्रतिनात्मक राष्ट्र गौरव है।
(2) लेकिन आजादी के 75 वर्ष के बाद भी देश का कोई राष्ट्रीय खेल नहीं है।
(3) विश्व में सभी देशों के अपने अपने राष्ट्रीय खेल हैं, ब्रिटेन का राष्ट्रीय खेल क्रिकेट है, अमेरिका का बेसबॉल, ब्राजील और फ्रांस में खेल फुटबॉल है।
(4) इसी प्रकार से हमारे देश में हॉकी, कुश्ती खेलों को राष्ट्रीय खेल घोषित करने कि दशकों से मांग चल रही है।
(5) लेकिन अभी भारत सरकार के द्वारा किसी खेल को राष्ट्रीय खेल घोषित नहीं किया गया है। जबकि तर्क यह दिया जाता है कि, सभी लोकप्रिय खेल विधाओं को प्रोत्साहित/प्रचारित करना है। इसलिए सरकार ने किसी भी खेल को देश का राष्ट्रीय खेल घोषित नहीं किया है, जो बचकान है.
(6) जोकि किसी भी खेल या कार्य को बढ़ावा देने के लिए, प्रोत्साहन करने के लिए बहुत ही आवश्यक होता है।
(7) इस विषय में जब भी कोई मांग की जाती है तो किसी एक खेल पर सहमति नहीं बन पाती।
(9) इसे एक खेल को ही नहीं एक से अधिक खेलों को बढ़ावा मिलेगा।
(10) देश में अधिक से अधिक खिलाड़ी मेडल ला घर संसार में देश का नाम ऊंचा कर सकेंगे ।
(11) जिससे देश का नाम रोशन होगा ।
(12) इसलिए आपसे निवेदन है कि राष्ट्रीय खेल घोषित किया जाए ।
(13) उम्मीद है इस पर सहानुभूति पूर्वक विचार करके जल्द कार्रवाई आरंभ की जाएगी
(14) कार्रवाई जवाब की प्रतीक्षा। धन्यवाद सहित।

Cricket 2.0: Football, Kabaddi, Hockey -Unveiling a Progressive New “Make In India” Playing Format for a Brighter Future for Aspiring Talent. ( Ref. PDF file - Cricket 2 Football, Kabaddi.)
⏎ Cricket has always been more than just a sport in India. It's a passion that unites millions of fans, offers fame to its stars, and generates substantial revenue. Its annual budget is approx. Rs.2000 crores (Rs.20 Billion).
⏎ Population is growing, unemployment is on the rise leading to criminal activities. However, as cricket continues to thrive, a significant number of budding talents are often left behind due to the limitations of the traditional playing format. In a bid to address this issue, a new cricket playing format is being suggested, one that could open up new avenues for aspiring cricketers while revolutionizing the game.
⏎ The Current Scenario: A Limited Playing Field:
⏎ The current cricket format restricts the number of players to 11 per team, with only a handful of specialist batsmen and bowlers. This limitation often results in talented players missing their chance to shine on the big stage. It's not just about missing out on personal glory but also about losing potential careers that could sustain these young talents and provide them with a livelihood.
⏎ Introducing a New Playing Format: Doubling the Opportunity:
⏎ The proposed format seeks to double the number of players in each team, allowing for a total of 24 players (11 specialist batsmen and 11 specialist bowlers/fielders). This innovative approach aims to level the playing field, giving more talented individuals the opportunity to showcase their skills.
⏎ The Key Elements of the New Format:
⏎ 1. Specialization: In this format, when batting, all 11 players will be specialist batsmen, ensuring that every ball faced is a genuine contest between bat and ball. Similarly, during fielding, all 11 players will be specialist bowlers and fielders.

⏎ मुझे ज्ञात है कि सरकार की अनेक जिम्मेदारियाँ और अनुरोध होते हैं, लेकिन मुझे आशा है कि मेरी अपील पर विचार किया जाएगा। युवाओं की प्रतिभा को विकसित करना न केवल युवा सशक्तिकरण का वादा पूरा करता है बल्कि हमारे राष्ट्र की प्रगति और गर्व में भी योगदान देता है।
⏎ मैं उत्कृष्टता की प्राप्ति के लिए एथलेटिक्स और शिक्षा में समर्पित रहना चाहती हूँ, लेकिन इस सपने को हकीकत में बदलने के लिए मुझे आपकी सहायता की आवश्यकता है। मुझे विश्वास है कि सही संसाधनों के साथ, मैं अपने परिवार और देश को गर्वित कर सकती हूँ।

I hope this letter finds you in good health and high spirits. I am writing to formally lodge a complaint and tender my resignation from the position of President of the Jodhpur Karate Association (Rural), effective immediately. This decision comes after discovering several serious irregularities and unethical practices within the association that I believe necessitate immediate action.
⏎ 1. Backdated Appointment Letter: Upon assuming my role, I was dismayed to find that my appointment letter was dated back to September, which is illegal and raises serious concerns about the administration's integrity.
⏎ 2. Commercialization of Karate: It has come to my attention that the association has transformed karate into a business venture, focusing on generating revenue through sponsorships and fees rather than promoting the sport and supporting the athletes. This approach is detrimental to the true spirit of martial arts.
⏎ 3. Questionable Belt Exams: The association has been conducting belt exams for students who have only been enrolled for 7 to 10 days. It is impossible for students to gain the necessary skills and knowledge in such a short period, making these exams illegitimate and undermining the credibility of our karate programs.
⏎ 4. Lack of Financial Transparency: The association does not maintain a balance sheet, conduct audits, or hold a bank account. All financial transactions are conducted in cash, which lacks transparency and accountability. Sponsorship funds and fees collected from students are not being utilized appropriately, further suggesting financial mismanagement and potential fraud.
⏎ 5. Unjustified Fee Increases: The fee for belt exams has been doubled from ₹1000 to ₹2000 without any valid justification. This exorbitant increase is yet another indication of the association's focus on profiteering rather than the development of karate.
⏎ 6. Affiliation Issues: The karate classes in all academies in jodhpur rural has been operating without proper affiliation

DOPPW/E/2024/0044698.d:
Harassment of a pensioner by ordering recovery of a huge sum from his pension ,that too, an amount which is not at all due to be recovered from him and also denying him payment of the amount due to be actually paid to him.
The Personnel Division of Sports Authority of India, New Delhi has ordered an illegitimate recovery of a huge sum of Rs. 2, 81,292 from the pension of
Sri [name], Retd. Deputy Director, SAI, Bangalore.In addition to this, a sum of Rs.1, 95,768 due to be paid to him by SAI has not been paid to him.
Letter with details of the matter, written by [name] P and T [name] Association to Shri [name], Director General, Sports Authority of India, New Delhi on 07-05-2024 delivered to SAI on 14-5-2024, requesting for his personal intervention to render justice to a pensioner of his organisation seems to have not got the attention of the D G SAI at all in as much as the Association has NOT got a reply so far, and the recovery of Rs.2,000 p.m. being made since June 2023 from the pension of Sri [name] is continuing.
The Issue in a nutshell is that Sri [name] after his transfer from SAI Bangalore to SAI Vishakapatnam in April 2015 continued to occupy staff quarters allotted to him in Bangalore and vacated the quarters on 09.11.2017.
⏎ SAI ordered deductions of rent at normal rate for the first 2 months, at double the normal rate for 6 months and damages for over stay at 45 times the normal rate for 22 months which was strictly in accordance with the Rules on the subject.
⏎ But most unfortunately, the Personnel Division of SAI New Delhi vide its order No.SAI/Pers/2217/2022 dated 19-09-2022 advised SAI Bangalore to recover the amount of Rs. 2,81,292 ie. HRA at Bangalore rates in addition to the rent at normal rate and damage rates. In its above letter to SAI Bangalore the Personnel division emphasized that the recovery of HRA at Bangalore rates - HRA of the City- in addition to rent ,ordered by it, is AS PER RULES and as ordered by the COMPETENT AUTHORITY. But it did not mention either the rule number which stipulates such recoveries or the name of Rule Book but simply mentioned that it is as per Rules.
⏎ When Sri [name] requested Director SAI Bangalore to supply him a copy of the RULE motioned in the letter dated 19-09-2022 of SAI, New Delhi, and supply him a copy of the order signed by the Competent Authority indicating the name and designation, the Executive Director SAI, Bangalore, perhaps being unable to find the relevant RULE, or the order signed the competent authority with designation, transferred the case to Deputy Director, Personal, SAI New Delhi for disposal. The matter rests there till now without a resolution
⏎ Failure on the part of SAI /New Delhi/ Bangalore to supply a copy of the RULE which states that HRA of the City must also be recovered in addition to Rent is ample proof of there being NO SUCH Rule at all.
Details of the amounts due to be recovered from the pensioner and the amounts due to be paid to the pensioner have been furnished in the letter dated 7-5-2024 written to the DG by the association as per which a sum of Rs. 1, 95,768 is due to be paid to the pensioner.
⏎ We strongly urge that SAI New Delhi may please be advised to review the matter in its entirety, IMMEDIATELY STOP RECOVERY OF RS.2,000 being made from pension of Sri [name] from June 2023, DELETE the entry of Rs.2,81,292 from the calculations that SAI had made, that is the entry relating to the amount of HRA at Bangalore rate which is not at all due to be recovered from him. Order immediate payment of Rs. 1,91,768 actually due to the pensioner as per the calculations furnished in the letter dated 7-5-2024 of the Association thereby ending the agony to which the pensioner has been forced into by ordering recovery of an amount which he is not supposed to pay and which has not been substantiated by quoting a RULE .

⏎ We humbly request you to ensure that all the players get the benefit of Flying Kick Sport, this will help in boosting the morale of the players and will help in making it more popular and spreading the indigenous flying kick sport across the world. FKSAI efforts to get the NSPO recognition, MOYAS.

I hope this letter finds you in good health and high spirits. I am [name] J [name], a resident of Porbandar, Gujarat, and an aspiring shooter. I am writing to bring to your attention my pending application for a sports arms license, submitted to the Honorable District Collector of Porbandar, Gujarat on 26th June 2021.
I’ve diligently followed up on my arms license application. Key dates include the initial application submission on 26th June 2021, reminders sent on 25th February 2022, 21st September 2023, and 9th October 2023, and the submission of a recommendation letter from the National Rifle Association of India (Ref No. NRAI/LIC/AT/2023) on 5th October 2023. Despite these efforts, the application remains pending since the last reminder sent on 19th October 2023.
In June 2023, I won a Gold medal in a Gujarat state championship in Ahmedabad, organized by the Gujarat State Rifle Association. Notably, I was the sole participant from Porbandar, Gujarat in the pre-national event held in Asansol, West Bengal by the National Rifle Association of India.

This license is essential for my target practice and participation in shooting competitions to improve my performance.
I understand the need for thorough review, but given the time since my initial application dated 26th Jun 2023, I kindly ask for your help to speed up the process.
I hope for a swift processing of my application to further my goals as a certified shooter. I’m prepared to supply more information or documents if needed.
I deeply appreciate the time and effort you’ve spent on this matter. Your assistance is invaluable to us. I am eagerly awaiting for a positive outcome of this matter.
Thank you once again.

प्रति
खेल मंत्रालय
भारत सरकार
⏎ विषय - जिला कार्यलय सुरजपुर छत्तीसगढ़ से संचालक रायपुर मिनी स्टीडियम स्वीकृति के लिऐ भेजे गए आवेदन क्रमांक 401/खे.यु.क/अ.धो.दिनांक 21/02/2024 के अनुसार ग्राम पंचायत - बांसापारा, पोस्ट-गंगोटी, तहसील -भैयाथान, जिला सुरजपुर में मिनी स्टेडियम के स्वीकृति के सम्बन्ध में।
महोदय,
विषय अतर्गत लेख यह है कि दिनांक 23/07/2022 में मुख्यमंत्री जनशिकायत पोर्टल के द्वारा ग्राम पंचायत - बांसापारा, पोस्ट-गंगोटी, तहसील -भैयाथान, जिला सुरजपुर में बांसापारा के लाल मैदान में मिनी स्टेडियम बनवाने का मांग किया गया था। जिसमे दिनांक 21/02/2024 को खेल कूद विभाग के सुरजपुर जिला कार्यलय से पुरा दस्तावेज तैयार कर संचालक खेल एवम युवा कल्याण विभाग रायपुर को मिनी स्टेडियम स्वीकृति प्रस्ताव भेज चुकी है।
यह मिनी स्टेडियम ग्राम पंचायत का एकमात्र खेल मैदान है इस पांच ग्राम पंचायत में 4300 लोग निवास करते हैं।
युवाओं के अभ्यास,योग, खेल, के साथ साथ अनेक सार्वजनिक कार्यक्रम लाल मैदान में आयोजित किया जाता है।
इस मिनी स्टेडियम के बनने से ग्रामवासियों को अनेक प्रकार से लाभ मिलेगा। ग्रामीण स्तर पर बड़े स्तर का खेल किया जा सकेगा।
अतः श्रीमान खेल मंत्री महोदय जी से निवेदन है कि जिला- सुरजपुर तहसील -भैयाथान ग्राम पंचायत-बांसापारा के लाल मैदान के लिऐ मिनी स्टेडियम स्वीकृत करने की दया करें।

To the International Cooperation of Sports
Regarding
Organizing Committee of the 5th World Deaf Athletics Championship,
⏎ We lodge a formal protest regarding a grave negligence in the measurement of the Men's Discus Throw final on July 19, 2024, during the evening session of the championship.
⏎ Sanjeev Kumar [name], representing India, made his sixth and final attempt with a distance of 42.92m. However, the officials mistakenly measured the distance from a point more than a meter behind the actual mark where the discus landed. This error deprived our athlete of a medal, the career and the opportunity to bring glory to the Nation.
⏎ The difference between Sanjeev's throw and the third-placed athlete's throw of 43.30m is a mere 38cms, highlighting the significance of this error.
⏎ Given the exceptional circumstances, we request your understanding in considering our protest beyond the 30-minute window. The negligence was not apparent during the competition, as the officials of various countries and spectators were seated behind the discus cage, making it impossible to detect the mistake with the naked eye.
⏎ We have reviewed the official live video of the event multiple times later in the evening to see his throws.So we request that you do the same to understand the true facts. We humbly request that you review the live video footage which is under your custody very thoroughly and grant justice to our genuine concern.
⏎ We request a re-measurement of the discus throw from the live footage you have in your custody, to rectify this situation.
⏎ Thank you for your attention to this matter.
⏎ Sincerely,
⏎ [name] Sanjeev Kumar
Participate in 5th Senior World Deaf Atheletics Championship At Taipei From India.

Haryana [number] INDIA

PRSEC/E/2024/0029572.d:
To,
The Honorable President of India
Subject: Revitalization of Annadel Ground in [address] for an International/National Football Ground.
Respected Sir/Madam,
I hope this letter finds you in the best of health and spirits. I am writing to draw your attention to a matter of significant historical and cultural importance concerning the Annadel Ground in [address]. 133rd Durand cup is going to start on 27th July of this month. So, at this precious time i would like to draw your attention towards importance of my topic.
As you may know, the Annadel Ground in [address] holds the distinction of hosting the world’s oldest football tournament, the Durand Cup (1888). This is the only competition in which the winner gets 3 Trophies. In which a trophy is also given by the President of our country. This prestigious tournament is a testament to our rich sporting heritage and is a symbol of our enduring love for football, which is the world's most popular sport. [address], a city with profound historical roots laid by the British Empire, now houses an army center and a golf course at this very ground.
As we all know what place the Durand Cup Football tournament holds not only in our country or even in the world, this competition is known as the one of the oldest competitions of the world. You will also be amazed & happy to know that the All-India Football Federation was also established on 23 June 1937 at the Army Headquarters, [address], the capital of Himachal Pradesh. Therefore, you will know how important this ground is for the football in our country. We can provide new energy to our Football game in the country by starting it again in [address] from where its seed was planted.
Currently, this ground is utilized by army and its limited number of officers for golf and leisure activities only. No one is allowed to play or go to this ground even considering the shortage of space in [address], it is necessary to make this ground available for sports.
Apart from this, there is very little flying on it by Army or state government. At present, helipads have been made at other places in [address], so I do not find it necessary to land them here only.
In light of the growing popularity of football globally and the pressing need to promote this sport within our country, I humbly propose the development of an international level football field at the Annadel Ground. This initiative would not only pay homage to our historical connection with the sport but also serve as a catalyst for promoting football in India. Furthermore, it would place [address] and India on the global football map, garnering international recognition and fostering greater engagement with the sport among our youth.
The transformation of this historic ground into a premier football facility would provide a multifaceted platform for various national and international tournaments, training camps, and football academies. It would also support the Government’s vision of sports development and encourage the youth to take up football, potentially unearthing future football stars for our country.
I am confident that with your esteemed support and the collective efforts of the concerned ministries, we can revive the legacy of the Durand Cup and utilize the Annadel Ground to its fullest potential. This project would be a significant step towards promoting sports culture in India and contributing to the overall development of our nation.
Thank you for considering this proposal. I look forward to your positive response and support in this endeavor.
⏎ Yours sincerely,
Dr. [name]
Coach/Assistant Professor (Football)
[address] of [address] [address] &
Directorate of [address] [address]
Youth Program H.P.U [address]-5
Ex. Member State Sports Council H.P

MOYAS/E/2024/0000142.d:
Youth Affairs >> Vigilance Related >> Vigilance matters for Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports
-----------------------
I am writing to express my concern regarding the recent privatization of the Major Dhyan Chand National Stadium in Delhi and the resulting increase in fees, which has made the facility inaccessible to many middle-class citizens. As a frequent user of the stadium's facilities, I have personally witnessed the benefits it provided to the community when it was under government management. The affordable fees allowed people from various economic backgrounds to utilize the sports amenities, promoting health, fitness, and the development of young athletes. However, since the transition to private management, the fees have increased significantly. This steep rise has made it difficult for many, including myself, to continue using the stadium's services. The current fee structure excludes a large portion of the population who relied on these facilities for their physical well-being and sports training. This situation is particularly detrimental to young aspiring athletes from middle and lower-income families who depend on affordable sports facilities to pursue their dreams. The increase in fees not only limits their access to essential training resources but also poses a risk to the overall development of sports at the grassroots level in our country. I urge you to consider the following recommendations to address this issue: Implement Regulated Fee Structures: Introduce regulations to cap the fees at a reasonable level, ensuring affordability for the majority of users. Provide Subsidies and Scholarships: Offer financial assistance to athletes and regular users from lower economic backgrounds to maintain their access to the facilities. Promote Public-Private Partnerships: Encourage a balanced approach where private management ensures efficient operation while keeping the facilities accessible to all. Initiate Community Programs: Develop community programs and events that are either free or low-cost to keep the community engaged and promote widespread.
MOYAS/E/2024/0000142.r: Sports is a State Subject and the subject matter raised by you pertains to UT of Delhi, therefore, you are requested to approach the concerned Department of UT of Delhi.

PRSEC/E/2024/0030993.d:
Dear PMO,
⏎ I hope this message finds you well. As a proud citizen of India, I am writing to express my concerns about certain persistent issues that continue to hinder our nation's progress. While India has made remarkable strides in various fields and stands tall as a spectacular country, there are aspects of our daily lives and societal behaviors that need urgent attention and transformation.
⏎ First, we Indians are excellent at justifying all the bad things in our country. I have seen us justifying our shortcomings, and I am shocked at how good we are at not accepting our failures. Indians are proficient in arguments, not actions. Many defend our mediocre, losing culture in the Olympics by citing funding and budget constraints.
⏎ Whether bad-mouthing China on its economy or Olympic records, we Indians excel at justifying the flaws in our system while China wins more medals and steadily becomes a superpower. We are real losers who can't accept that our system has failed. We will never be a force in the Olympics, and we will never win gold medals on the scale China does.
⏎ Even African countries, Cuba, and North Korea win at least 2-3 gold medals in their specific sports. There is no excuse; our athletes fail at the Olympics despite winning at world championships. Something happens, and they lose at the Olympics even if ranked in the top 10. The Olympics is a different beast where many countries compete with us, requiring dedication, hard work, and vision.
⏎ Look at our sports ministry and all the sports bodies. Do you see leadership interested in winning gold medals? No, they are just holding onto their positions for decades, enjoying the perks without accountability for poor performance. Getting a sports body chairmanship is seen as a way to placate a politician and bargain for the ruling party to keep everyone happy. No one cares if the person is helpful to the athletes.
⏎ Our athletes will always fail because of our arrogant politicians and egomaniacs holding positions of power without improving athletes' conditions. In India, sports are not seen as a serious profession. Families often scold children for showing interest in sports, pushing them to excel in school exams instead. It is impossible to cultivate a sporting culture in India when getting a job is prioritized over nurturing talent from childhood.
⏎ It is good to see our egos punctured; we are not special in anything apart from producing more babies and forcing them to study as if their lives depend on it. Family, society, and the ego of politicians are all responsible for the poor and pathetic performance of our athletes at the Olympics. We are happy to win even one bronze, while countries like Angola, Cuba, and North Korea win more gold medals.
⏎ To truly unlock our potential, we must transition into a nation of winners, embracing excellence in every aspect of our lives. This requires a monumental shift in our attitudes, from how we approach our studies and work to how we perceive and play sports. The government plays a crucial role in this transformation. Policies and initiatives should prioritize long-term benefits over immediate electoral gains.
⏎ It is time for bold actions and reforms that foster discipline, accountability, and a culture of excellence. We need to instill a sense of pride and responsibility in every citizen, motivating us to act in the best interest of our nation at all times, not just when prompted by external pressures.
⏎ Let us create the biggest transition the world has ever seen, setting a new standard for future generations and showcasing the true potential of India.
⏎ Thank you for your attention to this matter. I trust that with your leadership and commitment, we can initiate the necessary changes to propel our nation towards unparalleled greatness.
⏎ Warm regards,
[name]
(Indian Citizen)
[email]

⏎ "Right to education" of my son has been deprived of since he is 5 years old because no single government school for special children is available in India for mildly autistic children to get education in the prescribed way by medical experts.

Kindly also note that your Skill India flagship program does not include the employment guarantee needs of mildly autistic people in the differently abled persons category.

DSPRT/E/2024/0000260.d:
Sports >> Vision India
-----------------------
Dear Honourable PM
I am writing to propose an initiative that could significantly boost India's performance in future Olympic Games while also providing quality education to our youth. The proposal is to establish a nationwide network of Olympic Schools that would focus on developing world-class athletes while also offering a strong academic curriculum.
The rationale for this proposal is as follows:
1. Despite being the world's second-most populous country, India's Olympic performance has been disappointing. In the most recent Olympics, we secured only 6 medals and ranked 69th overall.
2. Many successful Olympic nations have systems in place to identify and nurture athletic talent from a young age. India lacks such a comprehensive system.
3.In olympic school prime focus of trainer will be on making kids olympic ready.
⏎ Key features of the proposed Olympic Schools:
⏎ 1. Early talent identification: Scout for athletically gifted children across the country, particularly in rural and underserved areas.
⏎ 2. World-class training facilities: Equip schools with state-of-the-art sports infrastructure and experienced coaches.
⏎ 3. Balanced curriculum: Offer a strong academic program alongside intensive sports training.
⏎ 4. Holistic development: Focus on nutrition, mental health, and character building in addition to physical training.
5. Partnerships: Collaborate with existing sports institutes, universities, and corporate sponsors to maximize resources and opportunities.
The goal would be to have India consistently rank among the top 10 countries in medal tallies within the next 8-12 years. This achievement would align with India's rising global stature in areas such as economic growth, military strength, and innovation.
⏎ I would be grateful for the opportunity to discuss this proposal in more detail and to contribute to its implementation if it aligns with your vision for India's sporting future.
⏎ Respectfully yours,
[name] [name]

Subject: Addressing Poor Participation and Performance in the Paris Olympics 2024: Need for Expanded Sports Infrastructure. Dear Sir, I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to express my concerns regarding the performance of Indian athletes in the Paris Olympics 2024. Despite our country’s vast population of 1.4 billion and very less investments in sports, we have seen disappointing results with only six medals, none of which are gold. This outcome reflects a critical underutilization of our potential and highlights the urgent need for systemic changes to enhance our sports infrastructure. One of the major factors contributing to this situation appears to be the insufficient number of training facilities and programs accessible to young sports aspirants. To address this, I propose the following: Expansion of SAI Facilities: Establish at least one Sports Authority of India (SAI) center in every state capital and district headquarters. This will ensure that aspiring athletes have access to quality training facilities and resources, regardless of their location. Enhanced Sports Awareness: By increasing the presence of SAI centers, we can raise awareness about various sports and provide young talents with the opportunity to explore and pursue careers in different disciplines. Local Talent Development: A more widespread network of SAI centers will facilitate the identification and nurturing of talent from grassroots levels, creating a stronger foundation for future Olympic success. Investment in Infrastructure: Improve and maintain the quality of existing sports facilities to provide a conducive environment for athlete development. It is imperative that we recognize the critical role that robust sports infrastructure plays in achieving our national goal of becoming a developed nation. A “Viksit Bharat” cannot be realized without significant advancements in our sports performance on the global stage.
