Its significance to millions of followers across the globe cannot be overstated.
⏎ While we acknowledge the importance of hosting a global event such as the Olympics and the need for urban development, we firmly believe that such progress should not come at the cost of erasing our spiritual and cultural landmarks. Demolishing the ashram would not only hurt the sentiments of countless devotees but also set a disturbing precedent of prioritizing temporary global attention over enduring heritage.
⏎ We urge the authorities to explore alternative sites for Olympic infrastructure development that do not involve disturbing spiritual centers. Respecting religious and spiritual sentiments is vital for social harmony and national identity.

-----------------------
विषय: नरेन्द्र मोदी जी, प्रधान मंत्री सरकार को जनहित में पत्र
⏎ माननीय प्रधानमंत्री जी,
⏎ मैं आपके समक्ष अपनी मांग, सुझाव और शिकायतें रखना चाहता हूं, जो मैंने पूर्व में भी पत्र के माध्यम से आपके संज्ञान में लाया था। मेरा विषय दिल्ली पुलिस टर्निंग कैंप वजीराबाद से जुड़ा है, जो एक महत्वपूर्ण मुद्दा है।
⏎ मैंने पत्र संख्या PMOPG/E/2024/0120690 के माध्यम से अपनी मांग रखी थी, जिसमें मुझे जवाब मिला कि दिल्ली पुलिस टर्निंग कैंप वजीराबाद आम जनता के लिए खुला है, लेकिन सुरक्षा कर्मियों द्वारा आम जनता को ग्राउंड में जाने की अनुमति नहीं दी जाती है। इसके बाद, मैंने अनेकों बार पत्र भेजे, लेकिन सभी में एक ही जवाब मिला कि मैं पेपर लेकर अधिकारी से मिलूं।
⏎ मैंने स्पष्ट किया था कि यह जमीन डीडीए लैंड है, जो केंद्र सरकार के अधीन है और वर्तमान में दिल्ली और केंद्र में दोनों जगह भाजपा की सरकार है। इसलिए, जनहित में स्टेडियम, पार्क, मैदान बनाकर क्षेत्रवासियों को दिया जाना चाहिए।
⏎ पत्र संख्या PMOPG/E/2024/017236 के जवाब में, दिल्ली पुलिस से पत्र आया (पत्र संख्या 2096/हॉप(P–111)DPA /JK,06/05/2025), जिसमें कहा गया है कि दिल्ली पुलिस अकादमी/वजीराबाद एक महत्वपूर्ण संस्था है और प्रशिक्षुओं की सुरक्षा एवं संरक्षा के लिए आम जनता के लिए प्रवेश प्रतिबंधित है।
दोनों जवाब अलग है कौनसा जवाब गलत है कौनसा सही ये तय करना मुस्किल है सच्चाई ये हैं की जो कार्य पहला पत्र मिलने के बाद ही हो जाना चाहिए था उसे कई वर्षों बाद भी जनहित मे कार्य नहीं हुआ ये सोचने का विषय है की एक जनहित मे कार्य के लिए वर्षों तक संघर्ष करना पड़ता हैं जिसमे सिर्फ सरकार को आदेश करना है जनता का पेसा लगाना है
मेरा कार्य है पत्र लिखना ओर सरकार को जनहित मे के करना देखते है कब ओर कीतने वर्षों तक इंतजार करना होगा जनता को
मेरी मांगें निम्नलिखित हैं:
⏎ 1. स्टेडियम, पार्क और फिजिकल ट्रेनिंग ग्राउंड का निर्माण: दिल्ली पुलिस टर्निंग कैंप वजीराबाद से लगी लगभग 80 बीघा जमीन डीडीए लैंड पर स्टेडियम, पार्क और फिजिकल ट्रेनिंग ग्राउंड बनाकर दिया जाए, जो क्षेत्रवासियों के लिए उपयोगी होगा।
2. अस्थायी अनुमति: जब तक निर्माण नहीं होता, दिल्ली पुलिस टर्निंग कैंप वजीराबाद में आम जनता को सुबह और शाम 3 घंटे घूमने की अनुमति दी जाए। गेट पर साइन बोर्ड लगाकर

• It was found that Miss [name] [name] deliberately concealed a pre-existing severe knee injury at the time of induction and submitted a false Medical Certificate declaring herself medically fit. ⏎ मेरा नाम [name] मेरे पिता का नाम सत्यप्रकाश साहू है सर/मैडम, मैं ग्राम:- पंचायत खपरीकला, तहसील:- डोंगरगांव, जिला:- राजनांदगांव, राज्य:- छत्तीसगढ का रहने वाला हूं। सर/मैडम जी, मैंने राज्य स्तरीय स्कूल जेम्स में स्वर्ण पदक प्राप्त किया था और मुझे पता है कि मैंने जिला स्तर पर भी स्वर्ण पदक मिला है। सर/मैडम जी, मैं बहुत गरीब परिवार से आता हूं, जिसके कारण मुझे किसी भी खेल में भाग लेने की अनुमति नहीं है। यह कहा कर मुझे निकल दिया जाता है। मुझे भाग लेने से मना कर दिया जाता है। और अब भी जब मैं खेलो इंडिया युवा जेम्स जैसी कई राष्ट्रीय प्रतियोगिताओं में जाता हूं, या कोशिश करता हूँ तो मुझे यह कहकर बाहर निकाल दिया जाता है कि मैं इस प्रतियोगिता के लायक नहीं हूं या मुझे इन सब चीजों से दूर रहना चाहिए इत्यादि। मुझे यह कहकर बाहर निकाल दिया जाता है सर/मैडम जी । मनिया महोदय जी न तो हमें कभी किसी भी तरह का पुरस्कार समारोह में शामिल किया गया और न ही हमें कोई वित्तीय सहायता मदद दी गई। जिस वजह से मैं अपनी प्रतियोगिताओं में भाग नहीं ले सका सर/मैडम जी। सर/मैडम जी, मैं आपसे निवेदन करता और चाहता हूं कि जिस वजह से अपने ग्राम, जिला, राज्य और देश के लिए खेलना चाहता था, जिससे मैं वंचित रहा हूं, मुझे वंचित न रखा जाए और मनिया महोदया सर/मैडम जी से निवेदन है कि किसी भी प्रकार का मदद मिले जिससे मैं अपने परिवार का जो गरीबी है उसे दुर कर सकूं और मैं अपनी प्रतियोगिताओं में भाग ले सकूं। मुझे किसी सरकारी अकादमी में शामिल होकर खेल के प्रति प्रशिक्षण दिया जाये और खलने का अवसर दिया जाये ताकि मैंने अपने जो जुनून को छोड़ दिया है/था मैं इसे फिर से शुरू कर सकूं और अपने देश,राज्य,जिला ,ग्राम, और अपने समाज और अपने परिवार का नाम रोशन कर सकूं।

⏎ माननीय प्रधानमंत्री महोदय,
⏎ विषय:- देश के सभी जिलों के विद्यालयों तथा हॉकी के जादूगर दद्दा ध्यानचंद की कर्मभूमि रही झांसी जिले के किसी भी विद्यालय में नहीं खिलाया जाता राष्ट्रीय खेल हॉकी।

⏎ माननीय प्रधानमंत्री महोदय,वर्ष 2025 भारतीय इतिहास में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है कारण देश संविधान पूर्ण रूप से लागू होने की प्लेटिनम जुबली वर्ष में प्रवेश कर रहा है।माननीय प्रधानमंत्री महोदय,आपके कुशल कार्यकाल में देश विकासशील से विकसित अवश्य बनेगा।माननीय प्रधानमंत्री महोदय,आपके संज्ञान में बहुत ही महत्वपूर्ण और गंभीर विषय लाना चाहता हूं जो देश के राष्ट्रीय खेल हॉकी से संबंधित है,आशा करता हूं आप इस विषय पर उचित चिंतन अवश्य करेंगे।

DSPRT/E/2025/0000298.d:
Sports >> Sports Federations Related >> Table Tennis
-----------------------
Currently, two associations are in existence with the same affiliation number (Rajasthan Sports Act 2005 – No. Kra. Sa/Rajya/034/2005). Both the associations are conducting the tournaments under the name of Rajasthan Table tennis Association. We have met several times with both the associations but none of them are willing to resolve the issue since 2022. Despite giving the representation from Rajasthan and winning the Medals in different categories in the National and Inter-National events, players are not being recognized for their efforts. Because of their dispute, each category has double set/number of players who are representing the Rajasthan State in the National event as TTFI 1 and TTFI. As Table Tennis Federation of India is not recognizing both associations for representing the Rajasthan state. Therefore, players of both the associations receive certificates namely TTFI 1 and TTFI 2. Per TTFI, these certificates/players are not a valid to use for the sports benefits like –
i. No actual representation from the Rajasthan state
ii. Recently, the state team qualified for the National Games but due to disputed faction from Rajasthan and were not considered to participate in the National Games
iii. No eligible for applying for the government jobs
iv. Any kind of sports reservation category
v. College/School admission
vi. Any kind of scholarship/grant program from public/private sector
vii. Not eligible for financial assistance from Rajasthan Sports Council
d. Due to the above-mentioned issues, the existence players are being demotivated and leaving the game. The new players are also not willing to enroll themselves for this particular sport (Table Tennis).
In consideration of the above-mentioned issues, we request to intervene to resolve the issue in the benefit of budding players who want to represent the Rajasthan state on the National and International podium.
DSPRT/E/2025/0000298.r: Sports being a State subject and the Ministry deals with the National Sports Federations in various sports disciplines. The State level associations or federations is not dealt by this Ministry. The Ministry vide letter dated 20.01.2025 (copy attached) has recognized Table Tennis Federation of India (TTFI) as National Sports Federation in the discipline of Table Tennis for the year 2024. You may directly approach to TTFI in this regard.

Subject: Immediate Action Needed: Revival of Indian Football
⏎ Respected Sir/Madam,
⏎ I write this as a deeply concerned citizen and passionate follower of Indian football. Despite our vast population and youth potential, our national team continues to underperform at every level—lacking technical skill, tactical intelligence, and even the basic spirit to compete. This is not a talent issue, but a clear failure in structure, vision, and execution.
⏎ Scouting is nearly absent at the grassroots level, resulting in thousands of talented players being left undiscovered. Coaching quality is inconsistent and outdated. Infrastructure outside of metros is poor or nonexistent. Most critically, there is no clear Indian identity in the way we play football—our players lack originality and often appear unprepared for the demands of international competition.
⏎ This is unacceptable for a country of India’s scale and pride. We urgently need:
• A national talent scouting and development mission across rural and Tier 2/3 cities.
• Investment in modern academies with licensed, well-trained coaches.

The Fund is managed by a Council constituted by the Central Government. Union Minister in charge of Youth Affairs and Sports is the Chairperson of the Council. ⏎ Expenditure and Accounts-
Proposals for financial assistance from reputed organization/institutes, engaged in promotion of sports, for development of sports infrastructure, procurement of equipment and other sports activities are considered and decided by the Executive Committee.
Decisions of the Executive Committee are implemented by the NSDF Secretariat
Guidelines have been formulated to streamline the processing of proposals under NSDF without compromising the in-built element of flexibility available in the Scheme.
Accounts of the NSDF are audited by C & AG.
Annual reports, along with audited statements of accounts are placed in both the Houses of Parliament.

विषय: ग्राम बरौर में बच्चों हेतु खेल मैदान एवं आवश्यक खेल सुविधाएं उपलब्ध कराने हेतु
⏎ महोदय,
⏎ मैं ग्राम बरौर, ब्लॉक मरवाही, जिला गौरेला-पेंड्रा-मरवाही, छत्तीसगढ़ का निवासी हूं। हमारे गाँव में बच्चों के लिए कोई भी खेल मैदान, झूले, फिसलपट्टी या अन्य खेल सुविधाएं उपलब्ध नहीं हैं, जिससे बच्चों के शारीरिक और मानसिक विकास में बाधा उत्पन्न हो रही है।
⏎ वर्तमान में:
1. ग्राम में कोई चिन्हित खेल मैदान नहीं है।
2. बच्चों को खेलने के लिए सुरक्षित स्थान नहीं है।
3. उपलब्ध खाली ज़मीन असमतल (अनलेवल) है, जिसकी घेराबंदी भी नहीं की गई है।
4. बच्चों के मनोरंजन हेतु झूले, फिसलपट्टी, और बेंच जैसी सुविधाओं का भी अभाव है।
⏎ अतः आपसे निवेदन है कि:
- ग्राम पंचायत में बच्चों के लिए खेल मैदान चिन्हित किया जाए।
- उक्त मैदान की समतलीकरण (leveling), घेराबंदी (fencing) की जाए।
- बच्चों के लिए झूले, फिसलपट्टी, और अन्य प्राथमिक खेल उपकरण लगाए जाएं।
- यदि संभव हो तो "खेलो इंडिया" योजना या राज्य की युवा कल्याण योजनाओं के तहत यह कार्य जल्द कराया जाए।
⏎ यह गाँव के बच्चों के स्वास्थ्य, विकास और भविष्य के लिए अत्यंत आवश्यक है।

⏎ सादर,

Respected Sir,
⏎ Thank you for your response regarding Grievance Online Registration Number PMOPG/E/2024/0122930.
⏎ I acknowledge that the designated Old Wrestling Hall serves as a Non-NCOE Field of Play (FOP) for the "Come and Play" wrestling athletes. It is true that the wrestling athletes enrolled under the "Come and Play" scheme are currently practicing at the Non-NCOE FOP (Old Wrestling Hall) within the NCOE Mumbai campus, and the facility is indeed in good condition. As such, there is no hindrance to their regular training and practice.
⏎ However, I would like to bring to your kind attention that despite having access to the facility, the absence of proper mentoring, guidance, and coaching poses a significant challenge. Young wrestlers cannot achieve their dreams of winning medals for the country without the support of trained and experienced coaches. Currently, no coach or mentor is available at the Old Wrestling Hall to guide these aspiring athletes.
⏎ My two daughters, aged 14 and 17 years, are both ambitious and hardworking. They aspire to become world-class wrestlers and bring national and international recognition to India. They have already shown promise by securing first place in district-level competitions and second place in state-level competitions (Under-14 category), entirely through self-practice and self-training. I am attaching the relevant certificates issued by the concerned authority for your kind perusal.
⏎ With the guidance and coaching of experienced professionals under the Sports Authority of India (SAI), I firmly believe that these girls can achieve great success and make the country proud.
⏎ I humbly request your kind intervention and support in facilitating access to proper coaching and mentoring for these young athletes under the "Come and Play" scheme.
⏎ Thank you for your valuable time and consideration. I look forward to your positive and encouraging response.
⏎ Yours sincerely,
[name]
DSPRT/E/2025/0000342.r:
The matter was examined, and the following information is provided in response to your grievance:
1. The two Wrestling Athletes, referred to by the complainant are regularly practicing at old wrestling hall (designated Non NCoE FOP) under the SAI come and play scheme as acknowledged by the complainant himself.
2. As such, SAI Wrestling Coaches at Mumbai are posted for the smooth operation and functioning of the NCoE Scheme, where elite athletes are trained towards achieving National and International laurels for the country.
3. The ‘Come & Play’ scheme in Wrestling at SAI NCoE Mumbai is operational in view of the public interest/benefit such that interested athletes may avail the benefits of SAI facility (Old wrestling hall, Non NCoE field of play).
4. Considering the total sanctioned strength of 60 NCoE athletes, the available NCoE Coaches are majorly occupied in the training of NCoE Athletes and accompanying them on tours as per competition calendar. Thus, making it difficult to deploy coaching resources to any other scheme, given the top priority of NCoE Scheme.
5. However, the concerns of the complainant are well acknowledged. It is to convey that efforts will be taken to see to it that NCoE Coaches may, from time to time provide mentoring/ coaching to come and play athletes training at old wrestling hall subject to time/ resource availability and approval of the Competent Authority such that NCoE training is not disrupted in line with Circular (File.22/SAI/Ops/NCoE-Miscellaneous/[number] dated 14.10.2024) (Copy Attached)
6. Moreover, the said athletes are also encouraged to participate in selection trials at various SAI STC/NCoEs or at SAI NSTC adopted Akharas where they may benefit directly from expert SAI Coaches and other benefits associated with the SAI schemes, subject to their selection in the mentioned schemes.

⏎ विषय: भारत में व्हीलचेयर क्रिकेट को मान्यता देने हेतु भावपूर्ण निवेदन
⏎ आदरणीय मोदी जी,
⏎ प्रणाम।
मैं सोमजीत सिंह, भारतीय व्हीलचेयर क्रिकेट टीम का कप्तान एवं व्हीलचेयर क्रिकेट इंडिया एसोसिएशन (WCIA) का सह-संस्थापक, यह पत्र केवल एक खिलाड़ी के रूप में नहीं बल्कि उन सैकड़ों दिव्यांग योद्धाओं की ओर से लिख रहा हूँ जो हर दिन सिर्फ एक बात के लिए लड़ते हैं—सम्मान, पहचान और समान अवसर।
⏎ व्हीलचेयर क्रिकेट हमारे लिए सिर्फ खेल नहीं, बल्कि जीवन जीने की एक प्रेरणा है। जब हम तिरंगे की जर्सी पहनते हैं, तो यह एक मौन गर्जना होती है—"हम भी भारत हैं"। हमनें अंतरराष्ट्रीय मैच खेले, जीत हासिल की, और उस समाज को जवाब दिया जिसने हमें कमज़ोर समझा।
⏎ लेकिन आज भी हमारा क्रिकेट मुख्यधारा में जगह नहीं बना सका है। हम दया नहीं चाहते, हम समानता चाहते हैं। हम विशेषाधिकार नहीं, बस न्यायपूर्ण अवसर की उम्मीद करते हैं। हमारी सबसे बड़ी इच्छा है कि व्हीलचेयर क्रिकेट को BCCI के अंतर्गत लाया जाए, ताकि हमारे खिलाड़ी भी पूर्ण राष्ट्रीय सम्मान के साथ ‘भारत’ के लिए खेलने का सपना देख सकें।
⏎ हमें ज्ञात है कि BCCI भारत सरकार के अधीन नहीं है, पर वह भारत की भूमि पर ही कार्य करता है। जैसे आप संविधान के रक्षक हैं, वैसे ही आप हमारे सपनों के भी रक्षक बन सकते हैं।
⏎ यदि यह पत्र आपके द्वारा पढ़ा जा रहा है, तो मैं आपसे करबद्ध प्रार्थना करता हूँ कि कृपया व्हीलचेयर क्रिकेट का ज़िक्र अपने आगामी मन की बात कार्यक्रम में करें। आपके मुख से निकला एक शब्द हमारे लिए इतिहास बन जाएगा। यह हजारों खिलाड़ियों को नई प्रेरणा देगा।
⏎ मोदी जी, कृपया हमारे परम मित्र बनिए। इस परिवर्तन के पहियों को आपकी कृपा से गति दीजिए। हमें भी भारतीय खेल के समावेशी भविष्य में स्थान दीजिए।
⏎ आशा और श्रद्धा सहित,

Allowing supervised public access to these areas would provide much-needed open spaces for children to play, women to sit and socialize under their supervision, and the elderly to walk and relax. -----------------------
Subject: Request for Urgent Regulation or Abolition of Jiu-Jitsu and MMA Events in India Due to Safety, Ethical, and Psychological Concerns
Sir,
I write this complaint with utmost concern regarding the growing popularity and unregulated conduct of Jiu-Jitsu and Mixed Martial Arts (MMA) tournaments in India. These combat sports, although gaining popularity globally, raise serious concerns in the Indian context due to their inherent brutality, lack of standardization, and the psychological and physical harm they can inflict—especially on minors and impressionable youth.
⏎ While MMA involves the use of fists, strikes, and ground-and-pound techniques, Jiu-Jitsu includes prolonged grappling, chokes, and joint locks that can lead to serious injuries or even fatalities if mishandled. These sports are not recognized by the International Olympic Committee, and most tournaments held are organized by private federations without any overarching safety guidelines or government oversight. Moreover, several instances have been reported on YouTube and other platforms where mixed-gender matches—particularly involving underage boys and adult women—are promoted in the name of training or competition, raising ethical and psychological concerns.
As a responsible citizen, I request the concerned authorities to:
Conduct a thorough review of the conduct and regulation of Jiu-Jitsu and MMA tournaments in India.
Investigate if minors are being exposed to inappropriate training methods or matches.
Issue clear guidelines and safety protocols under recognized sports federations.
If needed, consider banning or halting such events until proper safety measures and ethical standards are enforced.
A copy of my detailed complaint and observations has also been submitted to the NHRC, considering the potential violation of human dignity and safety.
I sincerely hope the ministry takes cognizance of this sensitive matter and initiates appropriate steps to protect athletes and uphold the ethics in India

I write this letter as a concerned citizen and stakeholder in the Indian shooting ecosystem to bring to your kind attention the grave and persistent irregularities being perpetrated by the current leadership of the National Rifle Association of India NRAI the apex body for shooting sports in the country
It has become increasingly evident that the functioning of the NRAI is marked by arbitrariness opacity and administrative high handedness which are severely affecting the careers and morale of hundreds of young Indian shooters
Most recently the NRAI published a list of selected athletes for the Junior World Cup 2025 New Delhi on its official website on 5th July 2025 This list stands in direct violation of its own published Shotgun Calendar which clearly states that the final team for the said event is to be selected only after the conduct of Selection Trial 4 The premature announcement of the team before Trial 4 is not only irregular and unjustified but also demonstrative of a premeditated intent to bypass fair and merit based selection
Furthermore the selection policy itself is ambiguous inconsistent and prone to misuse This year there have been widespread violations of international norms such as allowing overage athletes above 21 years to compete in junior categories during national championships an act that stands in blatant violation of ISSF Rule 37412 Such transgressions undermine the credibility of the sport demoralize deserving athletes and raise serious questions about the integrity of those at the helm
What is particularly alarming is the apparent haste with which decisions are being pushed through by the current regime before the end of their tenure raising concerns of mala fide intent and administrative overreach These actions are not only detrimental to the spirit of sportsmanship but also amount to systemic injustice and potential criminal intimidation of athletes and stakeholders
In light of the above I respectful urge PMO to desolve NRAI

Dear Sir Your Excellency Prime Minister of India Hon'ble Narendra Modi,
⏎ In the 1980s, during the Eelam War in Sri [name], I read in an astrological tabloid magazine, that Velupillai Prabhakaran was perceived as invincible, as the Sri [name] army could not conquer him because he had received a boon from the Goddess Kali, granted to him in response to his devotion, prayers, and penance he had carried out. The magazine also mentioned that Goddess Kali's vehicle is a tiger, which also served as the logo of the LTTE militant group.
⏎ Additionally, I have been thinking about how the cheetah is part of the same family as tigers, which Kali uses as her vehicle. This led me to ponder the possibility that an athlete could run as fast as a cheetah after receiving a boon from Goddess Kali through intense devotion, prayers, penance and yoga - they even could become invincible like Prabhakaran as well. If this were the case, then India could capture all the gold medals for athletics in the next Olympic Games.
⏎ I want to ask why India can't train its sportsmen and women to devote themselves through intense yoga, devotion, prayers and penance to the Hindu Gods, seeking a boon to achieve perfection and excellence when participating in any game? Wasn't India a country like this during Buddha's time? In my childhood, I have read Indrajal comic books about stories like these such as those of Drona's students.
⏎ Lastly, I would like to suggest that South Indian Tamils represent India in athletics at the upcoming Olympic Games. This suggestion comes from a common belief among my Sinhalese people that Tamils can see very well, but they can't walk - and we Sinhalese, on the other hand, can walk very well but can't see and are visually impaired. But however, based on my observations of the Tamil diaspora, I have seen that they are now more than capable of walking they can run as well, and their next achievement could be winning a gold medal for men's 400 meters at the next Olympic games.

⏎ Sports : seeking clarification/equivalency of BPES for admission into MPED course
-----------------------
I am a graduate of the Bachelor of Physical Education and Sports (BPES) programme from National Sports University (NSU), Manipur, which is under the administrative control of the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports. I am being denied admission to M.P.Ed. programmes at Delhi University and Central University of Haryana due to the non-inclusion of BPES degree in the eligibility criteria prescribed under NCTE norms.
⏎ As per current regulations, eligibility for M.P.Ed. includes:
⏎ “B.P.Ed. or equivalent OR B.Sc. (Sports) in Health and Physical Education with 50% marks.”
⏎ Despite the BPES degree being UGC-recognised and academically equivalent in structure, credit and curriculum to both B.P.Ed. and B.Sc. (PE), it is not explicitly recognised, and universities are rejecting applications at the document verification stage.
⏎ I cleared the physical fitness test held on 07/07/2025 at CUH, and officials acknowledged my eligibility in spirit but stated their inability to admit me due to absence of a formal recognition or circular from MoYAS or NCTE.
⏎ This oversight is causing discrimination and academic harm to meritorious NSU graduates. A similar situation was earlier addressed by MoYAS through a clarificatory notification regarding B.Sc. Sports Coaching and NIS Diploma equivalency.
⏎ Relief Sought:
⏎ 1. Issue an official clarification/circular stating that BPES from NSU is equivalent to B.P.Ed. or B.Sc. (Physical Education) for M.P.Ed. admission.
⏎ 2. Forward recommendation to NCTE to include BPES in the notified eligibility list.
⏎ 3.Urgently communicate and coordinate within ministry and request UGC for equivalency certificate, so that eligible students are not denied admission this year due to administrative ambiguity.
⏎ 4. send me copy of any letter of recommendation or communication about this matter between ministry and NSU so that there will be some formal document to support the provisional admission.

DARPG/E/2025/0011622.d:
To,
The Hon’ble Prime Minister of India
Prime Minister’s Office (PMO)
South Block, Raisina Hill
New Delhi – [number]
⏎ Subject: Immediate Provision of International Standard Shooting Equipment as a Legal and Policy-Based Right for a Committed Athlete
⏎ Respected Sir,
⏎ I am [name], a sportsperson from Uttar Pradesh, deeply committed to bringing laurels to our nation in the field of shooting. I have been consistently preparing with dedication, aiming to represent India at the highest level. However, due to the complete absence of essential international standard shooting equipment, my training and my dream to win medals for the country are under severe threat.
⏎ This is not merely a request — it is my right as a citizen and as a committed athlete, supported by constitutional provisions and government policies.
⏎ 1. Constitutional Mandate: Under Article 14 (Right to Equality) and Article 21 (Right to Life with dignity, which includes development of one’s potential), every citizen must be provided an equal platform to pursue their talent.
⏎ 2. Fundamental Duty (Article 51A): It is the duty of the State to encourage and promote excellence in sports. Denying the basic tools for training is a direct violation of this duty.
⏎ 3. National Sports Development Code of India (2011): It mandates the identification and nurturing of sporting talent, including the provision of equipment and infrastructure.
⏎ 4. Sports Authority of India (SAI) & Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS) Guidelines: Provision of ISSF-approved competition-grade equipment is a standard support measure for recognized and potential medal-winning athletes.
⏎ 5. International Standards: As per International Shooting Sport Federation (ISSF) rules, participation and training for international events require an ISSF-Approved 10m Air Rifle with Complete Competition Kit — including shooting jacket, trousers, shoes, gloves, and match-grade pellets.
⏎ Policy Gap & Discrimination:
It is important to highlight that current assistance policies unintentionally discriminate against financially weaker but highly talented individuals by requiring prior State/National participation. This is an impossible criterion for athletes who cannot afford the necessary equipment to even compete at the State level. Without initial support, such athletes are excluded from the very schemes meant to promote talent, which defeats the purpose of inclusive sports development.
⏎ Sir, despite writing multiple letters to the Uttar Pradesh Government and the Sports Ministry, no action has been taken so far. This continued delay is not only affecting my training but is also denying the nation a potential medal.
⏎ Therefore, I demand immediate provision of:
“One ISSF-Approved 10m Air Rifle (International Standard) with Complete Competition Kit (Shooting Jacket, Trousers, Shoes, Glove, and Match Pellets)”
as per my rights under the above legal and policy frameworks. I expect your office to take urgent action to ensure the equipment reaches me without further delay.
⏎ If no action is taken within a reasonable time, I will be compelled to initiate legal proceedings for enforcement of my rights under constitutional and policy provisions.
⏎ I hope you will treat this matter as urgent, not only for my personal growth but for the honour of our nation.
⏎ Yours faithfully,
[name]
Full Address: Vill-post: [address], [address], [address], [address], Uttar Pradesh- [number]
Mobile: [number]
Email: [email]
DARPG/E/2025/0011622.r:

⏎ We acknowledge your dedication and passion for the sport of Shooting. However, support provided under Target Olympic Podium Scheme is limited to Shooter / Athletes selected under the scheme. We wish you the very best for your future endeavors.

सेवा में,
जिला मजिस्ट्रेट महोदय,
जनपद गौतम बुद्ध नगरउत्तर प्रदेश।
⏎ विषय: ग्राम रौनी में खेल मैदान को चिन्हित कर सौन्दर्यकरण कराने हेतु प्रार्थना पत्र।
महोदय,
सविनय निवेदन है कि हमारा ग्राम रौनी (गौतम बुद्ध नगर) एक बड़ा ग्राम है, जहाँ बच्चों एवं युवाओं के लिए खेल-कूद की पर्याप्त सुविधाएँ उपलब्ध नहीं हैं। ग्राम में स्थित खेल का मैदान वर्तमान में अव्यवस्थित है खाता संख्या 00254 गाटा संख्या 60 कुल छेत्रफल 0.3260 तथा उचित चिन्हित एवं सौंदर्यीकरण न होने के कारण उसका उपयोग खेल गतिविधियों के लिए सुचारु रूप से नहीं हो पा रहा है।
ग्राम के बच्चों और युवाओं के उज्ज्वल भविष्य एवं शारीरिक विकास के लिए खेल मैदान का सुव्यवस्थित होना अत्यंत आवश्यक है। यदि प्राधिकरण द्वारा इस खेल मैदान को चिन्हित कर समुचित सौंदर्यीकरण (जैसे समतलीकरण, चारदीवारी, घास लगाना, पेयजल की व्यवस्था, बैठने की व्यवस्था आदि) कराया जाए तो ग्रामीणों एवं खिलाड़ियों को अत्यधिक लाभ होगा।
आपकी कृपा से ग्राम के बच्चों एवं युवाओं को एक सुरक्षित खेल स्थल उपलब्ध होगा।
अत: आपसे सादर निवेदन है कि ग्राम रौनी में खेल मैदान का चिन्हांकन कर उसका सौन्दर्यकरण कराने की कृपा करें।
सधन्यवाद।

Subject: Concern Regarding Sharp Increase in Skating Fee at Poorvi Delhi Khel Parisar
⏎ Play, recreation, and extracurricular activities are an essential right for every child. They not only support physical fitness but also help in developing confidence, discipline, and teamwork.
At present, the skating fee is ₹590 for non-member at Poorvi Delhi Khel Parisar, but it is now being increased to ₹1,875 plus GST—more than three times the current amount. We look forward to your positive consideration and a fair resolution in the interest of children.

Sanrakshan Trust

The Barauni Refinery Township Stadium in Begusarai, under the aegis of IOCL, has recently come under scrutiny for its policy of restricting entry to local residents and native people, branding them as outsiders. While it is within the rights of any organization or establishment to determine who they permit within their premises, a deeper moral question arises when the very people who have contributed their land and labor to establish industries—who are the backbone of this development—are marginalized and excluded. Such actions echo an unsettling historical pattern, reminiscent of colonial discrimination that India endured during the British rule. During the colonial era, British colonizers often justified their dominance by establishing segregated clubs, restaurants, and exclusive spaces that barred Indians from entry, labeling them as inferior or outsiders. These policies were rooted in racial discrimination, designed to segregate the oppressors from the oppressed, and to reinforce the superiority of the colonial rulers. The very essence of such segregation was the denial of basic dignity and equality to Indians, regardless of their contribution to the economy or society. Today, when local residents—who have dedicated their land, labor, and resources for the growth of industries like the refinery—face similar exclusion, it raises profound questions about societal progress and the true meaning of inclusivity. Excluding native people from spaces that belong to or are created by their land and labor not only distorts the principles of fairness and justice but also tarnishes the moral fabric of progress.
Khelo India 2025 football matches were held here, So if the government wants they can grant or acquire permission for social welfare to locals too. I request to make at least facilities for the local athletes to use this infrastructure with mutual understanding without any humiliations or restriction.
I have raised this same issue in Bihar Lok shikayat portal.

ग्राम के बच्चों और युवाओं के उज्ज्वल भविष्य एवं शारीरिक विकास के लिए खेल मैदान का सुव्यवस्थित होना अत्यंत आवश्यक है। यदि प्राधिकरण द्वारा इस खेल मैदान को चिन्हित कर समुचित सौंदर्यीकरण (जैसे समतलीकरण, चारदीवारी, घास लगाना, पेयजल की व्यवस्था, बैठने की व्यवस्था आदि) कराया जाए तो ग्रामीणों एवं खिलाड़ियों को अत्यधिक लाभ होगा।
आपकी कृपा से ग्राम के बच्चों एवं युवाओं को एक सुरक्षित खेल स्थल उपलब्ध होगा।
अत: आपसे सादर निवेदन है कि ग्राम रौनी में खेल मैदान का चिन्हांकन कर उसका सौन्दर्यकरण कराने की कृपा करें।
सधन्यवाद।

Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium Complex

⏎ Respected Sir,
⏎ I wish to draw your kind attention to the absence of any sports stadium or formal sporting infrastructure in Santuri Block, Purulia District, West Bengal. ⏎ The only existing district-level stadium is located in Purulia town under the Manbhoom Sports Association, which is too far for daily access by youth from Santuri due to logistical and financial constraints. Consequently, many promising athletes miss the opportunity to hone their skills.

⏎ If the Sports Authority of India authorizes the construction of a sports stadium in Santuri Block, it would not only foster a vibrant sports culture but also contribute significantly to the socio-economic development of the region. Improved access to sports facilities will help retain youth, encourage healthy pursuits, and elevate visibility and morale across the community.
⏎ I earnestly request SAI to consider establishing a sports stadium in Santuri Block, Purulia District at the earliest opportunity.

DARPG/E/2025/0013926.d:
Subject: Mismanagement at the Opening Ceremony of National Games, Dehradun
⏎ Dear Sir/Madam,
⏎ I wish to highlight the serious mismanagement that occurred during the Opening Ceremony of the National Games in Dehradun, Uttarakhand.
⏎ Thousands of people, including myself, were left stranded outside the stadium despite completing the official process to obtain valid passes. The sequence of events clearly shows a failure in management:
⏎ A day before the event, people were asked to scan a code, fill out a Google Form, and then provide their details to volunteers in order to collect passes. Many dedicated hours to this process.
⏎ However, on the event day, entry was allowed even without passes, completely defeating the purpose of this exercise.
⏎ The stadium soon exceeded its capacity, and genuine pass holders were denied entry despite their efforts.
⏎ To make matters worse, while many were left outside, certain groups were allowed entry through a separate gate, which raises serious concerns about favoritism and lack of transparency.
⏎ The situation escalated to the point where police were deployed to push people away from the gates. Families, women, and children suffered the most, as they were neither allowed inside nor permitted to even wait near the gates.
⏎ Many people had come from far-off areas, wasting two full days—one for collecting passes and the other for attending the event, only to return disappointed.
⏎ Some groups were split, with half the members inside and half outside, adding to the distress.
⏎ This reflects not only poor planning but also a complete lack of accountability. Such negligence tarnishes the image of Uttarakhand as a host for national-level sporting events.
⏎ I strongly urge the authorities to:
⏎ 1. Investigate and hold accountable those responsible for this failure.
⏎ 2. Ensure fair and transparent entry systems in future, strictly honoring valid passes.
⏎ 3. Prevent such chaos from ever repeating, as it damages public trust and the spirit of sports.
⏎ The National Games should have been a proud and joyful moment for Uttarakhand, but instead it became an event of disappointment for thousands. I hope corrective action will be taken at the earliest.

Thiruvananthapuram: A teenage kabaddi player’s chance to represent India has been lost due to the negligence of the State Sports Council, shattering her dreams of competing at the Asian Junior Championship.
⏎ Anjitha, a plus-two student from Arumanoor MVHSS, was selected for the Indian camp to be held in Bahrain, but officials failed to inform her on time. The council has since suspended two employees over the lapse.
⏎ The National Federation had notified the State Sports Council by e-mail on August 23 that Anjitha, the only player from Kerala, had been chosen as the ninth-ranked player for the Indian camp. She was required to submit documents, including her passport, to the federation before August 31. However, the Sports Council, which has been handling kabaddi administration for years due to disputes within the state association, did not inform Anjitha or her family. As a result, her spot was given to another player.
⏎ Council president Sharaf Ali admitted there had been serious negligence and said further inquiry is underway. Employees Vani Mookambika and Vinitha V Jayan were suspended in connection with the case.
Anjitha’s father, Suresh, is a labourer, while the Herculean Kabaddi Club in Parassala has been providing her training and support. Her sister, Anjana, also plays kabaddi. Coach Sachin said all of Anjitha’s documents, including her passport, had been prepared in advance, as she was confident of her selection.
There should be alternate ways to reach out and remind the Players. Since there is few more weeks before the event starts, we are kindly requesting the Kabaddi Sports federation to include teenager in the Team. Let her not suffer because of irresponsible council members

As per the Recruitment Notification dt 22.12.2023 Note to SN. 5, recruitment in each game will not be more than 10% of total number of vacancies in each category of post. There are 18 posts for Stenographer out of total 291 Posts. Hence,1 post for Stenographer is reserved for Yogasana.
⏎ The Applicant has applied for the post of Stenographer in Income Tax Department Mumbai under Yogasana Sport Category on 23.12.2023 after completion of 18 years on 13.11.2023 as per DoPT No.AB.14017/13/2013-Estt(RR)(1349) dt 6.3.2013. As per Recruitment Rules, Steno must pass 12th as minimum Qualification and 80WPM Shorthand with 50WPM Typing speed as Technical Qualification. The applicant has qualified all minimum Qualifications for a suitable Stenographer.
⏎ The Pr.DGIT(Admin) Delhi as Nodal Authority has confirmed that the petitioner has participated in Physical Efficiency Drive under Yogasana for all 4 years of 2020 to 2023.But, the petitioner has not played at International Level Competitions nor achieved any Medals. Since there is no winning position and only participation in Yogasana, the petitioner is not selected under Sports Quota under Yogasana. It is pertinent to note that Yogasana as Sports was given recognition vide DoPT OM No.14034/1/2013-Estt(D) dt 17.06.2022 and there are no international level competitions in Yogasana from 2020 to 2023. Hence, there are no Medals and only participation in Physical Efficiency Drive under Yogasana. Hence, the applicant is qualified as an Eligible Sportsperson under Yogasana as per DoPT OM 14034/01/2013-Est(D) dt 3/10/2013.
⏎ There are no international candidates who applied under Yogasana in Steno category. Out of total 291 posts, not a single post is given to Yogasana Sport. As per Recruitment Rules of Equal opportunity to each category of sports in each Post, at least 1 Steno post must be given to the applicant who is Eligible Sportsperson under Yogasana and also Suitable for the post of Steno after completing 18 years on 13.11.2023.
DSPRT/E/2025/0000509.r: The matter pertains to recruitment under the Sports Quota and falls within the purview of the Department of Personnel & Training (DoPT). The Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports deals only with matters relating to recognition and functioning of sports federations.

Respected Sir,
⏎ I write as a dedicated badminton player and concerned citizen to draw your attention to the ongoing, restrictive practices of the Badminton Association of India (BAI). This is not an isolated concern but a recurring issue, as BAI routinely issues circulars—like the attached recent example—warning all registered players against participating in so-called “unauthorized” events. These letters are regularly circulated through state associations across India, making it nearly impossible for players to participate freely in the sport.
⏎ Key Concerns:
⏎ Restriction on Participation:
BAI’s persistent policy bans registered players from national championships or official events simply for playing in independent or community tournaments. Such threats of disciplinary action undermine our fundamental right to play and develop, and discourage honest participation.
⏎ Unjustified Financial Burdens:
The introduction of a ₹1,000 annual fee for maintaining a “player account” (previously free and offering minimal value) adds an unnecessary financial burden on players. High tournament fees and substandard facilities further increase the cost of participation, despite BAI receiving government aid intended for player welfare.
⏎ Lack of Transparency and Opportunity:
Veteran and amateur rankings are rarely published, and only a handful of tournaments are organized each year. This lack of transparency and limited opportunity leaves many deserving athletes unrecognized and demotivated.
⏎ Authority Overreach:
BAI, a registered society and not a government entity, claims the authority to “authorize” or “unauthorize” public sporting events. This overreach limits the growth of the sport and discourages grassroots participation, while serving more to control than to nurture badminton in India.
⏎ Kindly do the needful and protect the human rights of an Indian citizen
⏎ Thanks,
[name]

Request to Reconsider Referee List for All India Police Powerlifting
Competition at Amaravathi , Andhra Pradesh sched
Respected Sir,
We are writing to you on behalf of the Andhra Pradesh Powerlifting Association regarding the upcoming All India Police Powerlifting Competition, scheduled to be held in Andhra Pradesh from 10th to 17th October 2025.
⏎ Our association has been in close coordination with the Andhra Pradesh Police Sports Board to help organize this event. As requested by the Director General of Police, we submitted a comprehensive list of qualified referees, equipment details, and support staff to ensure the championship's success.
⏎ However, we were surprised and concerned to receive the list of referees released by the All India Police Sports Board on 1ST September 2025 . The list does not include any referees qualified by the International Powerlifting Federation (IPF), Powerlifting India, or the Andhra Pradesh Powerlifting Association. The referees on the list appear to be from various, unrecognized groups, and none are members of the federations that govern the sport at the national and international levels.
⏎ As you know, Powerlifting India and Andhra Pradesh Powerlifting Association( affiliated with Powerlifting India ) are the only organizations, recognized by the International Powerlifting Federation, which is affiliated with the International Olympic Committee. Upholding the rules and standards of the IPF is crucial for the integrity of the sport. Allowing unqualified officials to officiate the competition could compromise the fairness and validity of the event, and may even put the athletes' safety at risk.
We respectfully request that the All India Police Sports Board authorities intervene in this matter. We urge you to take the necessary action to ensure that only eligible referees.
All relevant documents submitted herewith for ready reference
DSPRT/E/2025/0000527.r: The matter pertains to the All India Police Sports Control Board, which independently conducts such events. The association may take up the issue directly with the said Board, as this office has no role in the appointment of referees.

Sports >> Sports Federations Related >> Karate
-----------------------
Respected Sir/Madam,
⏎ We write this letter with hearts full of pride, but also with deep pain and urgency. For more than five years, the Karate India Organization has been nurturing thousands of children—our sons and daughters—who train day and night with only one dream: to raise the national flag high, and to bring glory to Bharat Mata.
In these years, our karate players have proven their strength at both national and international platforms. They have shed sweat and tears, conquered challenges, and stood victorious against all odds—yet their victories remain unsung, their spirit unrecognized, and their sacrifices unsupported by the very system they serve.
While other sports receive recognition, facilities, and encouragement, our karate players—be they young girls, small children, or hardworking youth—are struggling even for the most basic opportunities. It is heartbreaking that these warriors, who dedicate their lives to discipline, courage, and patriotism, are left to fight their battles alone. Every medal they bring is not just a personal achievement, but a national triumph—and yet, it comes without the respect that it deserves.
This is no longer just a request. It is a *need*. The future of thousands of karate players is at stake. Without government recognition and proper facilities, their dreams will die, and with them will die the chance for India to claim its rightful place in the world of martial sports.
Therefore, we, the Style Chiefs, the players, trainers, and the entire Karate family, united in one voice, make this urgent and heartfelt appeal:
- Recognize Karate officially under the Government of India and grant its players their rightful respect.
- Provide equal facilities, infrastructure, and resources as given to other recognized sports.
- Ensure that karate has equal standing and encouragement, so our youth feel dignified and motivated to serve their nation.
DSPRT/E/2025/0000530.r: The Ministry accords recognition to National Sports Federations strictly as per the parameters laid down in the National Sports Development Code of India, 2011. Recognition is granted only to one NSF in each discipline which fulfills the prescribed criteria relating to governance, elections, accounts, and nationwide activities.

To
Honourable Minister
Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports
Government of India, New Delhi
⏎ Subject: Request for Medical and Surgical Facilities for Mini Brazil Players of Shahdol, Madhya Pradesh under NHM
⏎ Respected Sir,
⏎ Shahdol district of Madhya Pradesh, widely known as Mini Brazil, already has a football academy that nurtures the immense talent of tribal youth. However, the academy and the players face a critical gap — there are no dedicated medical and surgical facilities to treat sports injuries, trauma cases, and emergency conditions.
⏎ Young athletes often suffer injuries during training and matches, but without surgical backup and sports medicine units, many careers are permanently damaged. This neglect also discourages tribal youth from pursuing sports as a profession.
⏎ Under the National Health Mission (NHM), specialist posts including General Surgery are sanctioned but remain unutilized in Shahdol. These resources can be extended to support the football academy and provide life-saving facilities to its players.
⏎ I therefore request the Ministry to:
1. Upgrade the existing Shahdol Football Academy with a dedicated Sports Medicine and Surgical Unit under NHM.
2. Ensure posting of General Surgeons and Sports Medicine Specialists at CHCs and the district hospital to support football players.
3. Create a referral link between the academy and NHM healthcare centres for rapid treatment of injuries.
4. Coordinate with the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare so that healthcare and sports development work together for the benefit of Shahdol’s tribal players.
⏎ Providing these facilities will secure the health of Shahdol’s Mini Brazil players, safeguard their careers, and fulfill constitutional obligations under Articles 14, 21, and 46.
⏎ Yours faithfully,
Dr [name]
MBBS, MS General Surgery
Email: [email]
Mobile: [number]

Subject: Complaint Regarding Corruption and Misconduct in Roller Skating Administration
Respected Sir/Madam,
We are writing to express our deep disappointment and concern over the RSFI, the national Federation which is virtually run by a single man and violating all constitutional norms of a federation.
To our shock and dismay, we recently witnessed the very individual namely Naresh Sharma against whom multiple complaints have been raised – the Former Secretary of the Roller Skating Federation of India – standing beside a Cabinet Minister in a public event. This not only reflects poorly on the system's accountability but also demoralizes honest athletes, coaches, and all those who believe in fair play and transparency.
Numerous roller skating bodies from various states have alleged serious irregularities and corrupt practices against this individual, yet these complaints continue to be ignored.
One of the most outrageous incidents that has come to light is that an international medal was awarded to the Former Secretary's daughter namely Miss Dakshita Sharma despite her not having participated in a team camp, selection trial or any game played in 20th Asian Championship held in South Korea from July 19 to July 30, 2025 and also not joined the team abroad. In short, the scenario you described is highly unrealistic. Without any involvement in the team's selection or games, a person is not considered a team member and would have no grounds to receive a medal. This is true for nearly all organized sports, from the professional leagues to international tournaments. We are, therefore, compelled to write again and request immediate attention to the following:
1. How is a person with multiple allegations allowed to be publicly endorsed by a Cabinet Minister?
2. What action is being taken regarding the fraudulent awarding of an international medal?
We request a written acknowledgement of this complaint for initiating an independent and transparent enquiry.

विषय: गैर-क्रियाशील पुराने विद्यालय भवन को ध्वस्त कर खेल एवं मनोरंजन मैदान के रूप में विकसित करने हेतु निवेदन
⏎ माननीय महोदय/महोदया,
⏎ सविनय निवेदन है कि ग्राम – करगी कला, जिला – बिलासपुर (पिन कोड [number]) में स्थित एक पुराना सरकारी विद्यालय भवन अत्यंत जर्जर अवस्था में है। यह विद्यालय कई वर्षों पूर्व स्थापित किया गया था, परंतु अब इसकी स्थिति इतनी खराब हो चुकी है कि यह पूरी तरह अनुपयोगी और असुरक्षित हो गया है। भवन की दीवारें और छत टूट चुकी हैं, जिससे कभी भी दुर्घटना होने की संभावना बनी रहती है।
⏎ वर्तमान में इस विद्यालय में कोई भी शैक्षणिक गतिविधि संचालित नहीं हो रही है। यह भवन लंबे समय से परित्यक्त है और इसकी भूमि के कुछ हिस्सों पर कुछ लोगों द्वारा अवैध कब्जा किया गया है, जो सरकारी भूमि का अनुचित उपयोग है।
⏎ अतः आपसे निवेदन है कि निम्नलिखित कार्य शीघ्र किए जाएँ –
⏎ 1. पुराने एवं जर्जर विद्यालय भवन को शीघ्र ध्वस्त किया जाए।
⏎ 2. विद्यालय की भूमि को समतल कर खेल मैदान के रूप में विकसित किया जाए, जहाँ बच्चे और युवक क्रिकेट, फुटबॉल, वॉलीबॉल आदि खेल सकें।
⏎ 3. पूरे मैदान के चारों ओर मजबूत सीमा दीवार (boundary wall) का निर्माण किया जाए ताकि भविष्य में कोई अवैध कब्जा न हो सके।
⏎ 4. मैदान में सोलर फ्लड लाइट्स लगाई जाएँ ताकि संध्या के समय भी खेल गतिविधियाँ संचालित की जा सकें।
⏎ 5. बुजुर्ग लोगों के बैठने हेतु बेंच एवं शेड का निर्माण किया जाए।
⏎ 6. व्यायाम एवं स्ट्रेचिंग पोल्स लगाए जाएँ ताकि युवाओं में शारीरिक फिटनेस की भावना बढ़े।
⏎ यदि यह भूमि खेल एवं मनोरंजन मैदान के रूप में विकसित की जाती है तो यह ग्राम के युवाओं और नागरिकों के लिए अत्यंत उपयोगी सिद्ध होगी तथा स्वास्थ्य, खेल और सामाजिक विकास को प्रोत्साहन मिलेगा।
⏎ अतः आपसे निवेदन है कि इस विषय में तत्काल कार्रवाई करते हुए इस क्षेत्र का विकास कार्य संबंधित योजना (ग्राम विकास या पीडब्ल्यूडी विभाग) के अंतर्गत करवाया जाए।
⏎ आपके सहयोग एवं ध्यान हेतु धन्यवाद।
⏎ भवदीय,
ऋषभ द्विवेदी
निवासी – ग्राम करगी कला
जिला – बिलासपुर, छत्तीसगढ़ – [number]

खेल राज्य का विषय है, इसलिए देश में खेलों को बढ़ावा देने और विकसित करने की जिम्मेदारी मुख्य रूप से संबंधित राज्य, केंद्र शासित प्रदेश सरकारों की है। केंद्र सरकार महत्वपूर्ण अंतराल को पाटकर उनके प्रयासों में सहायता करती है। इसलिए, राज्य सरकारों से सहायता लेने का सुझाव दिया जाता है।
⏎ मंत्रालय की योजनाएं इस मंत्रालय और भारतीय खेल प्राधिकरण (www.yas.nic.in/sports, www.sportsauthorityofindia.nic.in) की वेबसाइटों पर सार्वजनिक रूप से उपलब्ध हैं। यदि आवश्यक हो, तो आप उचित प्रस्ताव के माध्यम से संबंधित योजना के तहत सहायता के लिए आवेदन कर सकते हैं।

Such infrastructure facilities will provide a new and positive direction to the youth of our village, keeping them away from anti-social activities and making a significant contribution to their physical and mental development. We firmly believe that you will sensitively consider this just request of ours and take prompt and appropriate steps so that our village can become more healthy, active and progressive.Awaiting your positive response.

⏎ Fix accountability for planning and execution failures.
⏎ Halt maintenance allocations until the pool is made operational.

GOVHY/E/2025/0013473.d:
I am submitting this grievance seeking urgent intervention and investigation by the Registrar of Societies, Government of Haryana, under the Haryana Registration and Regulation of Societies Act, 2012, regarding the functioning, renewal, and compliance status of the Haryana Table Tennis Association (HTTA), which is registered as a sports society in the State of Haryana.It has been observed that the Haryana Table Tennis Association (HTTA), which is affiliated to the Table Tennis Federation of India (TTFI), has failed to comply with several statutory provisions of the Haryana Registration & Regulation of Societies Act, 2012, as summarized below:
⏎ Non-disclosure of renewal status: As per Section 12 of the Act, every society must renew its registration every five years. HTTA has not published or disclosed any renewal details or certificate.
⏎ No annual filings or audited statements: Under Sections 24 to 26, every registered society is required to file its audited balance sheets, annual reports, and list of office-bearers with the Registrar annually. However, HTTA has not made such filings publicly available for any of the past five years (2019–20 to 2023–24).
⏎ Absence of democratic elections: Section 20 of the Act requires that the governing body be elected democratically at least once every five years. HTTA’s official website (htta.in
) lists office-bearers but does not mention the date, notice, or minutes of its last election or AGM, suggesting non-compliance with statutory provisions.
⏎ Non-filing of AGM minutes and annual returns: As per Section 23(2) and Section 25, failure to submit annual returns or AGM records empowers the Registrar to order an inspection or cancel registration after due notice.
⏎ Lack of transparency: No public disclosure has been made regarding the association’s membership register, list of affiliated district units, or financial statements, which are mandatory records under the Act.
⏎ These repeated violations indicate possible mismanagement, absence of statutory oversight, and violation of Sections 12, 20, 24, 25, and 34–38 of the Haryana Registration & Regulation of Societies Act, 2012.
⏎ Hence, I most respectfully request your good office to:
⏎ 1)Initiate a formal inquiry/inspection under Section 34 of the Act into the affairs and records of the Haryana Table Tennis Association.
⏎ 2)Direct HTTA to submit its audited financial statements, annual returns, and AGM minutes for the last five financial years (2019–20 to 2023–24).
⏎ 3)Verify the registration and renewal status of HTTA, including registration number, date, and current validity.
⏎ 4)Take appropriate action under Section 38 or Section 49 for violation of mandatory filing and governance obligations.
⏎ 5)Appoint an inspection officer or Returning Officer to verify whether proper elections were held and governance norms observed.
⏎ This grievance is submitted in the public interest to uphold transparency, accountability, and lawful governance in registered societies functioning as State sports associations.
⏎ I request acknowledgment of this grievance and a copy of the Action Taken Report (ATR), including the registration details and compliance status of the Haryana Table Tennis Association, within the stipulated time frame.
⏎ Thanking you for your attention and assistance

Sir, this is a matter that can be addressed under Civil Aviation Ministry but the Ministry will take it up only if approached by the Sports Ministry. We need to travel with sports equipment and airlines charge us, making things difficult as explained below.
We grateful to GoI for including Lawn Tennis as one of the sports in focus for the 2036 Olympics. We are middle class parents and cost of sports as competitive level is something we struggle to bear. I have removed him from normal schooling and put him in NIOS (open school) to allow him to train all days a week. He has been winning or performing well at AITA tournaments. As parents this is a huge risk I am taking and its my commitment to help produce a good sports person for my country. I look forward to GoI support in this matter that will help us tremendously for all sport persons by approaching Civil Aviation Ministry to make airlines allow an extra piece of baggage with sports equipment free with a reasonable weight capping.

Subject: Request for urgent independent inquiry into alleged financial irregularities – SAI LNCPE Trivandrum (Cycling Unit)
⏎ Respected Sir,
⏎ I seek your urgent intervention regarding serious allegations of financial misappropriation, falsified bills, and irregular procurement in the Cycling Unit of SAI LNCPE, Trivandrum. The matter concerns Assistant Cycling Coaches Mr. [name] and Mr. [name], and involves misuse of funds collected from athletes as well as SAI allocations during national events and training camps.
⏎ Summary of Allegations
⏎ During the November 2024 National Championships, athletes stayed at Tamil Nadu Physical Education & Sports University hostel, yet forged private hotel bills were submitted in athletes’ names and reimbursed from SAI funds.
⏎ Food bills were inflated to approx. ₹480 per day despite the university canteen diet rate being ₹200.
⏎ Estimated misappropriation totals ₹9–10 lakh.
⏎ Mr. [name] (YP, ARM Cycling) was allegedly aware but passed the bills.
⏎ A written complaint was filed on 19 February 2025 a show-cause notice issued on 1 August 2025, but no further action has followed.
⏎ A committee formed on 26 September 2025 reportedly includes an official who has worked closely with one accused coach, raising conflict-of-interest concerns.
⏎ Requested Action
⏎ I request that SAI kindly:
⏎ Order a time-bound, independent investigation (preferably external).
⏎ Review bills, vouchers, procurement and payment records from Nov 2024 to date.
⏎ Freeze payments and consider administrative suspension where prima facie evidence exists.
⏎ Ensure inquiry members have no prior association with the accused.
⏎ Recover funds and initiate disciplinary/legal action where proven.
⏎ Provide support to affected athletes, many of whom reportedly struggled to fund travel due to misappropriated money.
⏎ This matter urgently requires fair, transparent action to protect athletes’ interests and uphold SAI’s integrity and India’s sporting mission.
⏎ Thanking You
DSPRT/E/2025/0000596.r: Inviting attention to the application under reference, you are hereby informed that on receipt of complaints regarding commitment of financial misappropriation by Sh. Anil Kumar and Sh. Radhey Shyam, Cycling Coaches SAI LNCPE, a detailed inquiry was conducted at the RC level. On the basis of the findings of the detailed inquiry committee the file has been sent to Coaching Division, SAI HO for initiating appropriate action in this regard.

To: The Honourable Prime Minister of India.
⏎ Subject: Urgent appeal for intervention regarding the administrative and legal halt of the 63rd National Roller Skating Championship – 2025.
⏎ The Problem: The championship is indefinitely delayed due to legal and administrative disputes within the RSFI, as confirmed by the Federation itself. This instability is severely damaging the careers and morale of thousands of skaters across India.
⏎ Impact on Athletes:
⏎ Academic Stress: The Nationals occur during critical school and college exams (December). The uncertainty forces children to risk irreversible academic loss as they cannot commit fully to either training or studies.
⏎ Wasted Effort: Families have invested years of time and money. This dedication is now jeopardized by an internal power struggle.
⏎ Momentum Loss: The delay crushes the spirit of young skaters inspired by recent success, like Anandkumar Velkumar becoming India's first World Champion. The Nationals are the vital stepping stone for future global medalists, and the pipeline is now blocked.
⏎ Call for Urgent Action:
⏎ We request your personal intervention to protect these athletes by:
⏎ Expediting Resolution: Pushing for an immediate legal resolution to the RSFI's internal conflicts.
⏎ Appointing an Ad-hoc Committee: Immediately appointing an impartial Ad-hoc Committee under the SAI to finalize the necessary championship dates, venue, and rules, pending the final court verdict.
⏎ Prioritizing Skaters: Ensuring the resolution adheres to the Sports Code, prioritizing the welfare and competitive needs of the athletes.
⏎ We urge you to safeguard the future of these young champions and the spirit of 'Khelo India.'
DSPRT/E/2025/0000597.r: The issues relating to the conduct of the 63rd National Roller-Skating Championship – 2025 is presently sub judice before the Hon’ble High Court of Andhra Pradesh, and the Ministry cannot intervene while the matter is under judicial consideration. Appropriate action, as permissible under law, will be taken upon the Court’s final directions.

GOVHY/E/2025/0013764.d:
I am the parent of Ms. [name] (School No. VGK-1564) who was admitted to MNSS Rai, Sonipat in Class VI during mid-session in October 2024 after re-advertisement of admission seats. At the time of admission, the school collected full year fees of Rs 1,49,700 through Demand Draft No. [number] dated 14.10.2024 drawn on SBI, although the admission was in mid-session. The breakup of fee included Rs 50,000 as Security Deposit, Rs 30,500 as Boarding Lodging and Stationery, Rs 40,000 as Tuition Fee, Rs 20,000 as Clothing Money, Rs 7,200 as Personal Account and Rs 2,000 as Admission Fee.
⏎ Later I also deposited Rs 46,466 through SBI Collect for the first term of session [number] as demanded by the school. My daughter stayed in the hostel and attended school only for few months i.e. from October 2024 to February 2025 in Class VI and April to May 2025 in Class VII. We withdrew her admission in July 2025 due to personal reasons and sent withdrawal request by email dated 09.07.2025. For release of School Leaving Certificate (SLC), we were again asked to deposit Rs 3,281 which was paid under pressure.
⏎ My daughter’s withdrawal was properly communicated and all dues were fully cleared. In fact, the SLC was issued only after obtaining NOC from all concerned departments, which clearly confirms that nothing was pending against her. However, the school has not refunded the Security Deposit of Rs 50,000 till date.
⏎ As per the school prospectus, the Security Deposit is refundable after deducting dues, if any, and may be forfeited only in case of pending dues at the time of withdrawal. Since all dues were cleared, there is no justification for forfeiting the deposit. Moreover, as per Haryana Sports Department Order No. Sports-Estt-Rai-2025/19435 dated 12.05.2025 ( copy attached), MNSS Rai has already been directed to refund Security Deposit and partial fees to another student in similar circumstances. This clearly establishes that such refund is permissible and reasonable.
⏎ I had earlier written to the Principal through multiple emails dated 21.08.2025, 28.08.2025 and 04.09.2025, followed by a detailed written request sent through Registered Post Ref No. [id] dated 29.09.2025 (delivered on 04.10.2025). However, no response has been received till date.
⏎ The school has thus failed to act on genuine parental request and is withholding refundable deposit and excess fee despite clear precedents and directions. This amounts to arbitrary fee collection and deficiency in service.
⏎ I am enclosing herewith a copy of my detailed grievance letter addressed to the Principal along with all relevant annexures such as fee receipts, email correspondence, withdrawal request, proof of payment, SLC copy, registered post acknowledgement and copy of Haryana Sports Department Order dated 12.05.2025 for reference and necessary action.
⏎ It is therefore requested that suitable directions may kindly be issued to MNSS Rai Sonipat to refund my Security Deposit of Rs 50,000 and excess fees charged for unutilized period, and to take appropriate action for non-compliance of Haryana Government and CBSE guidelines.

-----------------------
Subject: Request for Clarification Regarding Non-Inclusion of Ball Badminton in SGFI National Level Games
⏎ Respected Sir/Madam,
⏎ I am writing this letter to bring to your kind notice the concern of many students, teachers, and sports lovers regarding the non-inclusion of Ball Badminton in the National Level School Games conducted by the School Games Federation of India.
Ball Badminton is one of the oldest indigenous sports of India, widely played across Our country since 1961 and 6 players are recieved Arjun Award.It is a game that promotes fitness, teamwork, and discipline among students and has been recognized by the Ball Badminton Federation of India (BBFI), which is affiliated with the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India.
In many state-level school tournaments, Ball Badminton continues to have a large number of participants and is part of the physical education curriculum. However, despite its popularity and official recognition, it has not been included in the SGFI National Games for the past several years. This has created disappointment among students who practice and perform well at the state level but are unable to progress further due to the absence of a national platform.
Through this letter, I respectfully request the School Games Federation of India to kindly provide an official clarification on:
1. The reasons for not including Ball Badminton in the SGFI National Games calendar.
2. Whether SGFI has any future plans to reintroduce Ball Badminton at the national level.
Providing a clear explanation will help students, schools, and coaches understand the current position of the sport and plan accordingly. It will also restore faith among young athletes who aspire to represent their schools and states in this traditional Indian game.
I sincerely hope that the SGFI will take this concern into consideration and respond with a clarification, and if possible, take necessary steps to include Ball Badminton once again in the National level

Respected Sir,
I am working as a Scientist–C at the Wadia Institute of Himalayan Geology (WIHG), Dehradun, an autonomous research institute under the Department of Science & Technology (DST), Government of India. I am an active sportsperson in 10-metre air pistol shooting and have officially qualified in the State-level Championship (under the Odisha State) organized under the aegis of the National Rifle Association of India (NRAI).
Through this grievance, I seek clarification and necessary action regarding my eligibility to avail sports incentives, and benefits applicable to Central Government employees who are sportspersons, as per the guidelines issued by the Department of Personnel & Training (DoPT).
As per DoPT norms, various incentives such as special casual leave, TA/DA and entry fee reimbursement for participation in official events, and recognition or monetary rewards for outstanding sports achievements are admissible to Central Government employees who are sportspersons. However, it is unclear from the norm whether I am eligible for these incentives in the same manner, or not.
In recent years, India has witnessed remarkable success in 10-metre air pistol shooting, with athletes such as Manu Bhaker, Esha Singh, Samrat Rana, and others bringing international medals and recognition to the country. Encouraging participation in this Olympic discipline among government employees would strengthen India’s sporting culture and motivate others to pursue excellence.
I therefore request the concerned authority to kindly:
1. Clarify whether the DoPT sports incentives are applicable to scientists of autonomous institutes like WIHG.
2. Provide the relevant orders or circulars governing such applicability.
3. Advise the procedure and competent authority for availing these benefits, if applicable.
⏎ Name: Dr. [name]

Institute: Wadia Institute of Himalayan Geology, Dehradun

DSPRT/E/2025/0000613.r: The Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports deals only with administration and recognition of National Sports Federations (NSFs) and has no role in extending DoPT sports incentives to employees. These incentives are primarily for regular Central Government employees and do not automatically apply to autonomous institutes like WIHG unless explicitly adopted by DST or your institute’s Governing Body. You are requested to approach WIHG Administration/DST with your achievement certificate for necessary clarification and processing.

Government of India
⏎ C/C:-

Government of India
New Delhi
⏎ Respected Sir,
Greetings.
I would like to bring to your kind attention an important concern regarding the scheduling of the upcoming T20 IPL and T20 World Cup matches during the 10th and 12th Board Examination period in February and March.
⏎ Students appearing for these examinations are at a highly sensitive and decisive stage in their academic and psychological development. At this age, they are easily influenced by external distractions and may not be able to regulate their focus effectively. Major sporting events such as the IPL and World Cup generate tremendous excitement, media coverage, and social engagement, which can significantly divert students' attention from their studies.
This situation creates additional stress for both students and parents, affecting concentration, learning ability, and academic performance. The Board Examination phase is already a period of high pressure, and the presence of such large-scale entertainment events may further increase anxiety levels and reduce study time.
As future citizens of our nation, students require a supportive and distraction-free learning environment during this crucial academic period. It is therefore the moral responsibility of the State and concerned authorities to ensure that their education is protected from avoidable disturbances.
In view of the above, I sincerely request that the T20 IPL and T20 World Cup matches scheduled during February–March be postponed until the completion of the Board examinations, in the best interest of students' academic well-being and future.
Thanking you for your attention and consideration.
⏎ Yours sincerely,
[name]

Mumbai Vizhithezhu Iyakkam
Mumbai

I am submitting this complaint as a concerned parent and stakeholder regarding the selection of the Junior Shotgun Team for the ISSF Junior World Cup 2025. The records show procedural lapses, lack of transparency, and deviation from the selection policy, affecting fairness and integrity.
1. Team declared before completion of Selection Trial 4
The final team was published on 5.07.2025 while Trial 4 was scheduled to conclude on 7.09.2025. Announcing the team before completing all trials violates the selection calendar and denies athletes a fair chance.

Subject: Complaint Regarding Unauthorized and Excessive Match Fees Charged by DDCA-Affiliated Cricket Clubs in Delhi
⏎ Respected Sir/Madam,
⏎ This is to formally bring to your attention a matter of significant concern regarding the financial practices of cricket clubs affiliated with the Delhi and District Cricket Association (DDCA).
⏎ Background:
⏎ The DDCA has approximately 84 or more affiliated clubs that are intended to provide essential cricket practice and match opportunities to children and aspiring cricketers in Delhi.
⏎ The DDCA receives funding from the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI), and subsequently, the DDCA is understood to provide financial assistance/funding to its affiliated clubs.
⏎ The Issue:
⏎ Despite receiving financial support, these affiliated clubs in Delhi are charging unexpected and excessive amounts from children/parents for providing match opportunities. This practice contradicts the spirit of the funding provided by the BCCI and DDCA, which should ideally make cricket more accessible and affordable.
⏎ Request for Action:
⏎ I urge the DDCA/BCCI to look into this matter immediately. Specifically, I request that you:
⏎ Investigate the financial records and fee structures of all affiliated clubs to determine the legitimacy and necessity of the match fees being charged.
⏎ Establish a clear, standardized, and strictly enforced fee cap for coaching and match participation for all DDCA-affiliated clubs, ensuring that the benefit of BCCI/DDCA funding is passed on to the children.
⏎ Take appropriate action against any club found to be charging fees that are exploitative or unauthorized.
⏎ This step is crucial to ensure that financial barriers do not prevent talented children from underprivileged backgrounds from pursuing a career in cricket.
⏎ Thank you for your time and prompt attention to this urgent matter.
⏎ Sincerely

Sports >> Khelo India Scheme.
-----------------------
This grievance is submitted in public interest regarding procedural irregularities observed in the recruitment process conducted for the Khelo India State Centre of Excellence (KISCE), Pune, for posts advertised in September 2025.
⏎ KISCEs are established under the Khelo India Scheme of the Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports, implemented with the Sports Authority of India (SAI), and are expected to follow transparent, fair, and uniform recruitment procedures as publicly funded national institutions.
⏎ However, the recruitment process at KISCE Pune appears to have deviated from standard norms, as outlined below:
1. The advertisement mentioned a publication date of 19.09.2025 with the last date of application as 26.09.2025. Public search-engine indexed records indicate that the advertisement became publicly accessible only on 26.09.2025, effectively coinciding with the last date of application.
2. No interview schedule (date, time, or venue) was publicly notified.
3. No shortlisted or final selection list was published on any official platform.
4. For five advertised posts, only ten candidates were reportedly called for interview, without any disclosed shortlisting criteria.
5. Original document verification of qualifications and experience was reportedly not conducted.
6. Results were reportedly communicated informally on the same day, without written communication or official publication.
7. Unlike KISCE recruitments in other States, the Pune advertisement mentioned only a single fixed payment amount, without a pay range or merit-based variation.
8. The official KISCE Pune website was reportedly non-functional during and after the interview phase, restricting access to recruitment information.

I wish to bring to the notice of the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports a serious administrative and coordination issue affecting open water swimming athletes across the country.
The Khelo India Beach Games 2026 are scheduled from 5 to 10 January 2026, with Open Water Swimming events on 9 and 10 January 2026. At the same time, the Swimming Federation of India has scheduled the SFI National Open Water Swimming Championships 2025 on 9 and 10 January 2026 at Mangalore, Karnataka, including multiple age group events such as Under 13 3 km and senior categories.
This direct clash between two nationally important and recognised events has resulted in many eligible athletes being forced to choose between the Khelo India Beach Games, a flagship Government of India initiative, and the SFI National Championships, which as per the SFI circular may be considered as a qualifier meet for International Open Water Swimming Events for the year 2025 to 26.
Such overlapping scheduling defeats the objectives of athlete development, fair opportunity, and participation promoted under Khelo India and national sports policy. Athletes train for months and years for these opportunities, and the conflict caused by lack of coordination between a National Sports Federation and Government sports programs results in avoidable exclusion and hardship to athletes and families.
This grievance is not individual specific but systemic in nature and affects swimmers from multiple states and age groups.
I respectfully request the Ministry and Sports Authority of India to review this matter, ensure better coordination between Khelo India and National Federations, and take appropriate corrective steps to prevent recurrence of such conflicts and to safeguard athlete interests.

⏎ यह कॉम्प्लेक्स खेलो इंडिया योजना के अंतर्गत निर्मित सरकारी खेल सुविधा है, जिसके दिशानिर्देशों के अनुसार राज्य/राष्ट्रीय/अंतरराष्ट्रीय स्तर के सिद्ध खिलाड़ियों को निःशुल्क, कमजोर वर्गों को नाममात्र शुल्क एवं सामान्य जनता, स्कूलों, कॉलेजों एवं खेल संघों को सुलभ पहुँच अनिवार्य है । पारदर्शी बोली प्रक्रिया से निजी निकायों को लीज की अनुमति है, किंतु उच्च सदस्यता शुल्क वाला विशेषाधिकारपूर्ण क्लबकरण सरकारी नीतियों के विरुद्ध है, विशेषकर जब उत्तर प्रदेश खेल नीति-2023 एवं हालिया कैबिनेट निर्णय के अनुसार इसका संचालन भारतीय खेल प्राधिकरण (साई) को सौंपा जाना प्रस्तावित है । रखरखाव हेतु फूड कोर्ट आदि राजस्व स्रोत अनुमत हैं, किंतु मूल खेल सुविधाओं का क्लबकरण वाराणसी के स्थानीय खिलाड़ियों एवं आमजन के हित में अनुचित है ।
⏎ यदि एसोसिएशन गैर-लाभकारी है एवं आयकर अधिनियम की धारा 12AB के अंतर्गत पंजीकृत, तो सदस्यता शुल्क पर जीएसटी से छूट प्राप्त है, क्योंकि यह सेवा आपूर्ति नहीं मानी जाती । व्यावसायिक उपयोग पर 18% जीएसटी लागू हो सकता है, किंतु सरकारी सुविधा होने पर यह अनुचित है एवं खिलाड़ियों पर अतिरिक्त बोझ डालता है ।
⏎ कृपया इसकी उच्च स्तरीय जाँच हेतु उत्तर प्रदेश सरकार को निर्देश दें, ताकि कॉम्प्लेक्स को मूल उद्देश्य के अनुरूप सुलभ बनाया जाए, ऊँचे सदस्यता शुल्क समाप्त हो, जीएसटी हटाया जाए, स्थानीय खिलाड़ियों (जैसे बैडमिंटन प्रेमियों) को प्राथमिकता मिले

प्रकरण: विगत समय में जिला जालौन में आयोजित सांसद खेल स्पर्धा में जनपद के प्रतिभावान खिलाड़ियों ने विभिन्न खेलों में प्रतिभाग किया और विजय प्राप्त की। नियमानुसार, प्रदेश के अन्य जनपदों (जैसे- झाँसी, ललितपुर, कानपुर आदि) में विजयी खिलाड़ियों को प्रमाण-पत्र के साथ-साथ निर्धारित इनामी राशि व प्रोत्साहन किट भी प्रदान की गई है।

3-विचित्र स्थिति: जब खिलाड़ियों ने इस विषय में क्षेत्रीय सांसद महोदय से संपर्क किया, तो उनके द्वारा यह कहकर पल्ला झाड़ लिया गया कि वह सत्ताधारी दल से नहीं हैं, उन्हें कार्यक्रम में आमंत्रित नहीं किया गया और वह इस विषय में कुछ नहीं कह सकते।

अन्य जिलों की भांति यहाँ के विजयी खिलाड़ियों को भी तत्काल इनामी राशि/प्रोत्साहन राशि दिलाने की कृपा करें।

⏎ माननीय महोदय,

⏎ हमारे गाँव में बड़ी संख्या में युवा खेलों व शारीरिक गतिविधियों में गहरी रुचि रखते हैं। परंतु एक उचित खेल स्टेडियम या मूल खेल मैदान के अभाव में, हमारे गाँव के युवा प्रभावी ढंग से अभ्यास नहीं कर पाते और अपने कौशल का विकास नहीं कर पाते। वर्तमान में, बच्चे व युवा खिलाड़ी खुले खेतों में अभ्यास करने को मजबूर हैं। किंतु निरंतर कृषि कार्य व फसल उगाए जाने के कारण, उन्हें खेलने के लिए पर्याप्त स्थान नहीं मिल पाता। खेत में दाना (फसल) होने की वजह से मैदान उपलब्ध नहीं हो पाता, जिसके कारण उनकी खेल प्रतिभा दब कर रह जाती है।
⏎ हमारे गाँव ने कई प्रतिभाशाली खिलाड़ी दिए हैं, और यदि उचित सुविधाएं प्रदान की जाएं, तो वे जिला, राज्य और राष्ट्रीय स्तर पर और भी बेहतर प्रदर्शन कर सकते हैं। एक अच्छी तरह बना खेल स्टेडियम न केवल युवाओं को खेलों की ओर प्रोत्साहित करेगा, बल्कि उन्हें नकारात्मक गतिविधियों से दूर रखने तथा उनके शारीरिक एवं मानसिक विकास में भी सहायक होगा।
⏎ मैंने इस मामले पर पहले संबंधित राज्य प्राधिकारियों से संपर्क किया था, परंतु अब तक कोई ठोस कार्रवाई नहीं हुई है। खेलों के राष्ट्र-निर्माण एवं युवा विकास में महत्व को देखते हुए, मैं अब विनम्रतापूर्वक आपके सम्मानित कार्यालय का, एक अंतिम उपाय के रूप में, दरवाजा खटखटा रहा हूँ।
⏎ अतः, मैं पीएमओ से विनम्र अनुरोध करता हूँ कि कृपया हमारे गाँव में एक नए खेल स्टेडियम के निर्माण को स्वीकृति देने का विचार करें। यह पहल हमारे युवाओं के लिए एक बहुत बड़ा सहारा होगी और हमारे क्षेत्र के समग्र विकास की दिशा में एक महत्वपूर्ण कदम होगा।
